In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Function as a Technical Specialist or lead role providing guidance and expertise over Conventional Power Generation Projects and Teams
  • Develop electrical drawing deliverables including:
    • One line and three-line diagrams
    • Electrical motor schematics, breaker control schematics and wiring diagrams
    • Power cable sizing and cable schedules
    • Complex engineering calculations such as: load flow, short circuit, motor starting (ETAP or SKM), Arc flash analysis (ETAP or SKM), protective relay settings, battery and charger sizing
  • Develop electrical equipment specifications and Bills of Materials (BOM) for procurement and construction
  • Create man hour budgets and schedule for projects and proposals
  • Attend on-site meetings, investigate existing conditions, interface with clients and provide support during construction
  • Extensively use Microsoft Office business systems such as ProjectWise, electrical engineering software, such as ETAP and Computer Aided Drafting Tools, such as AutoCAD to view and manipulate engineering drawing files

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Standards:

  • Continues to learn, remains current and applies independent knowledge and interpretation about departmental design guides, standards, systems, applicable engineering codes and Customer policies and procedures relative to assigned tasks

Quality/Continuous Improvement:

  • Consistently and independently applies knowledge and complies with customer quality program relative to assigned tasks
  • May be responsible for ensuring compliance with customer quality program
  • Provides guidance and direction to others from the same project and discipline
  • Supports continuous improvement and change management efforts

Engineering Production:

  • Prepares a variety of complex engineering deliverables
  • Performs complex research and develops recommendations for equipment and/or materials selection
  • Prepares complex engineering calculations following standard methods and principles
  • Manages assigned budget, schedule, and quality requirements
  • Plans and conducts independent evaluation, selection and adaptation of engineering techniques, procedures and criteria
  • Reviews lower level engineering work or assignments
  • Is responsible for one or more of the following: overseeing collection, assimilation, and management of data for engineering work; leading smaller production teams; and serving as the responsible charge for a project

Project Coordination:

  • Actively coordinates with all other internal/external team members on moderately complex projects

Client Focus:

  • Responsible for assisting with identification of key client interests and drivers on less complex projects
  • Communicates client interests and drivers to project team members and develops approaches to accommodate these concerns in the performance of the work on less complex projects
  • May provide support to business development or pursuit activities

Knowledge Sharing, Innovation and Technology:

  • Recognized as a technical specialist by the division having in-depth knowledge of an engineering process and/or of technical aspects of an industry
  • Designs a complete project of moderately complex scope within an assigned practice area(s)

People Management - (supervision, career development, training, mentoring):

  • Typically assists with performance management process, mentoring, recognition, and any corrective actions required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience and expertise in utility scale conventional power generation project design
  • Previous engineering consulting design experience in LV/MV Power
  • Quality Assurance / Quality Check (QA/QC) and project lead experience
  • Understand and be able to work within a schedule and manhours budget
  • Familiarity with applicable NEC and IEEE/ANSI standards
  • Experience with electrical equipment, which includes, but is not limited to: MV and LV switchgear, Secondary unit substation Transformer -GSUT, UAT, panel boards, breakers, protective relays, inverter, battery, battery chargers, disconnect switches, surge arrestors, medium voltage cable, low voltage cable, control cable, fiber optic cable
  • Written Communications
  • Drive For Results
  • Priority Setting
  • Planning
  • Delegation
  • Directing Others
  • Conflict Management
  • Informing
  • Listening
  • Dealing with Ambiguity and Building Effective Teams
  • Intermediate knowledge of engineering design principles and applicable design guides and standards related to assigned engineering discipline

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 5 years related work experience All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

Certifications

raw.title: Senior Staff AI Deployment Strategist
raw.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As an AI Deployment Strategist (Customer Outcome Leader) within Forward Deployment Engineering, you are the single-threaded business owner responsible for driving realized value, user adoption, and long-term expansion across our enterprise AI engagements.


Deploying enterprise AI is fundamentally different from traditional software delivery—it mutates operational workflows, alters decision-making rights, and spans multiple complex technical streams.


Working directly alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who build and optimize the technical architecture, you own the business realization.


You will bridge the gap between executive AI vision and day-to-day operational reality, ensuring our solutions deliver clear, measurable ROI while insulating technical teams from reactive firefighting and unmanaged scope creep.


Key Responsibilities

1. Single-Threaded Business & Value Ownership

  • Own end-to-end business success, ROI realization, and user adoption across high-impact enterprise accounts (e.g., global consultancies, Fortune 500 enterprises).
  • Establish baseline metrics, define target KPIs, and continuously measure, track, and present realized financial and operational value to client executives.
  • Serve as the primary peer and strategic advisor to client executive sponsors (CIOs, CTOs, Chief AI Officers, Business Unit Leads).

2. Multi-Stream Governance & Scope Control

  • Unite and govern complex, parallel workstreams (agent orchestration, guardrails/security, data pipelines, UI integration, and change management) under a single strategic roadmap.
  • Act as the strict gateway for engagement scope—eliminating unmanaged scope creep, managing client expectations, and translating ad-hoc requests into structured roadmap decisions.
  • Prevent technical teams from falling into reactive firefighting by maintaining clear operational boundaries and structured delivery cadences.

3. Workflow Redesign & Operational Change Management

  • Deeply analyze client operating models to identify high-value business problems and redesign operational workflows around AI capabilities.
  • Manage organizational change, address user inertia, and re-align decision rights to ensure end users actively adopt AI tools into daily workflows.
  • Conduct user feedback loops to refine the business solution, ensure outputs meet operational standards, and drive change management programs.

4. Partnership with Technical Delivery (FDEs)

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to translate business requirements into actionable technical user stories.
  • Protect engineering bandwidth by owning executive stakeholder management, business politics, and operational blockers, allowing FDEs to focus proactively on core technical architecture, evaluations, and system reliability.

5. Account Expansion & Value Scaling

  • Proactively identify adjacent, high-value enterprise use cases to expand account footprint post-initial deployment. • Turn successful proofs-of-concept (POCs) into multi-year, enterprise-wide production deployments.

Qualifications

  • 6–10 years in management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain), forward-deployed engineering, technical account management, or forward-deployed strategic roles in high-growth B2B SaaS/AI companies.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of enterprise AI deployments, large language models (LLMs), multi-agent systems, and digital workflow transformation.
  • Executive Presence: Proven track record of aligning, advising, and holding accountability with C-suite executives and senior enterprise stakeholders.
  • Business Acumen: Demonstrated ability to construct business cases, model ROI, design KPIs, and re-engineer complex operational business processes.
  • Technical Literacy: Ability to speak fluently with engineers, understand technical trade-offs (e.g., latency vs. accuracy, guardrail evaluation, data integration patterns), and translate technical complexity into business impact.
  • Change Management: Strong background in organizational design, user adoption, and driving behavioral change across large operational teams.

Core Competencies & Leadership Attributes

  • Single-Threaded Accountability: Takes complete ownership of business outcomes without deflecting to technical or operational complexity.
  • Scope Discipline: Firmly manages client expectations and resists unmanaged feature creep while maintaining high-trust executive relationships.
  • Strategic Clarity in Ambiguity: Able to bring order to fragmented, multi-stream AI initiatives and establish clear direction amidst rapid technological change.
  • Cross-Functional Catalyst: Bridges the cultural and operational gap between technical engineering teams and non-technical business leaders.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$112,900.00 - $182,600.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship?: Yes

raw.title: Fundraising & Grants Member Advisors
raw.excerpt: OVERVIEWFractured Atlas is seeking two full‐time Member Advisors - one Grants & Member Advisor and one Fundraising & Member Advisor.
raw.description:
OVERVIEW

Fractured Atlas is seeking two full‐time Member Advisors - one Grants & Member Advisor and one Fundraising & Member Advisor. Fractured Atlas is a national, fully remote nonprofit arts service organization. Our work is guided by the belief that some of the boldest, most urgent creative work happens outside of institutions, led by individual artists, emerging collectives, and grassroots organizations. Our mission is to make the journey from inspiration to living practice more accessible and equitable for artists and creatives. We run the largest fiscal sponsorship program in the country, supporting thousands of active projects in every creative medium across all 50 states. Through fundraising tools, educational resources, visa letters, community programming, and 1-on-1 support, we help artists access the funding, time, and community they need to make the art the world needs.

A successful candidate in both roles will be a creative problem solver and quick learner who has an enthusiasm for the arts, is incredibly personable over the phone and email, possesses a high level of patience and understanding (particularly as it relates to explaining the same information multiple times), and is able to operate and respond in a fast-paced environment while remaining calm and collected. The Grants & Member Advisor will have expertise around supporting our fiscally sponsored projects through the grant process from application through reporting. The Fundraising & Member Advisor will have expertise around advising our fiscally sponsored projects on fundraising and donation processes, including individual appeals, crowdfunding, giving day campaigns, donation policies and processes, and donation investigation.

Candidates with a work history that includes grant writing, fundraising, development, and/or customer service will likely excel. Since Fractured Atlas works virtually, these positions require strong self-motivation and both will be remotely supervised by the Associate Director of Education & Engagement.

At Fractured Atlas, we individually and collectively work hard to carry out our organization’s mission. We also understand that work is just one part of life and, through a culture of care, support team members having full and robust lives outside of work. With that foundation, our organizational culture embraces people who are open to:

  • Building trust with others and addressing equitable distribution of responsibilities when collaborating.
  • Learning new ways of working while welcoming change as a way to reshape processes/policies/programming that no longer serve our values.
  • Transparency in communications, decision making, and feedback.
  • Centering care and connection in our individual work and in relation to our colleagues.

We recognize that the culture and core values of an organization should continue to evolve to reflect the world we live in. At any given time, we recognize that there might be emerging values other than ourstated values and we continue to have conversations about stated and emerging values.

Additionally, at Fractured Atlas we work to adhere toanti-racism and anti-oppression principlesin all areas of our internal and external work. This commitment is grounded in our belief that change is possible, and that our work and that of the artistic community as a whole will grow stronger as oppression is eliminated.

In our current phase of this journey towards being an Anti-Racist Anti-Oppressive organization, the whole staff is engaged in all staff ARAO meetings led by rotating teams and undergo training as part of their onboarding process. We recognize that we do not have all of the answers as we pursue this work. This work will continue to shift as the Fractured Atlas team changes. We ask that new team members join us as we continue to learn, practice, and grow in this work. Learn more about what it’s like to work at Fractured Atlashere.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

BOTH MEMBER ADVISOR ROLES:

  • Manage ongoing email communication with artist members through Zendesk.
  • Conduct consultative and onboarding calls using Calendly and Zendesk Talk.
  • Review and approve fundraising materials, including grant applications, individual appeals, and crowdfunding campaigns.
  • Demonstrate Fractured Atlas’ software tools and provide walk-through support to members and fellow Member Advisors as needed.
  • Troubleshoot login, navigation, and other basic access issues.
  • Other duties as assigned to support the team and our members

GRANTS & MEMBER ADVISOR ROLE:

  • Provide member advising and grant administration support for Fractured Atlas’ fiscally sponsored projects:
    • Manage a high volume of grant application reviews while meeting funder deadlines and maintaining accuracy and consistency.
    • Review grant guidelines, applications, budgets, and supporting materials to assess eligibility, ensure compliance, and provide constructive feedback.
    • Advise members on applying for grants through fiscal sponsorship and communicate revisions, missing information, deadlines, and next steps.
    • Review and approve grant-related fundraising materials before submission.
    • Review and approve grant final reports, including narrative and financial reporting requirements.
    • Process grant award payments, review award documentation, and track payment and reporting requirements.
    • Correspond with members and funders regarding applications, awards, payments, required documentation, and final reports.
    • Maintain accurate grant records and handle sensitive member, funder, and financial information with care and discretion.
    • Collaborate with the Grants Manager and Programs team to improve grant-review processes and strengthen member education.

FUNDRAISING & MEMBER ADVISOR ROLE:

  • Provide member advising and financial administrative oversight for Fractured Atlas’ fiscal sponsorship and fundraising tools:
    • Manage a high volume of support queries and reviews while meeting deadlines and maintaining accuracy and consistency.
    • Advise artist members on the use of Fractured Atlas’s fiscal sponsorship program, including its fundraising and financial tools, and how to follow donation and financial procedures.
    • Review and approve fundraising materials: including profile/general support edits, individual appeals, third-party giving campaigns, and crowdfunding campaigns.
    • Support donation tracking and investigation, including logging donations in Airtable, confirming matching gifts, and resolving donation-related issues.
    • Correspond with members and donors regarding returned or disputed donations.
    • Provide back up support with artist visa services program.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

BOTH MEMBER ADVISOR ROLES:

  • Knowledge of the fundraising landscape and grant application processes
  • 1-2 years experience or strong familiarity with web-based software (Slack, Google Drive, Airtable, Trello, Zendesk, Calendly, or any ticketing or CRM software)
  • Experience with individual time management in a remote-work environment
  • Possesses self awareness of their professional needs in the workplace
  • Strong collaboration and team communication skills
  • Experience handling sensitive information and tracking specific details with accuracy
  • Experience explaining policies, procedures, or technical processes to non-expert audiences
  • A successful Member Advisor, Programs on the Programs team will be passionate about or committed to:
    • Advising and/or educating artists and creative business owners
    • Streamlining processes and training others to do the same
    • Exercising research, analytical, and investigative skills to problem solve.
    • Using and exploring new technologies
    • Efficient, effective, understanding communication
    • Managing a personal workload
    • Staying flexible and juggling changing priorities
    • Knowing when to take initiative, follow direction, and when to pause
    • Engaging in collaboration and teamwork
  • Experience in arts administration, arts management, or information technology - a plus!
  • Direct experience with financial oversight - a plus!

GRANTS & MEMBER ADVISOR ROLE:

  • 2+ years Direct experience with grants oversight or grant application review.
  • Direct experience with New York State Council on the Arts grants - a plus!

FUNDRAISING & MEMBER ADVISOR ROLE:

  • 2+ years of experience in a member, customer, or client support role - financial, fiscal sponsorship, or compliance-related experience a plus!
  • Experience reviewing materials or requests against established guidelines and making approval decisions
  • Knowledge of donation, payment, or transaction processing

LOCATION

This position is U.S.-based and 100% virtual (with travel about 1-2 times per year*). You can live anywhere in the country but most meetings fall during a 9 AM-6 PM ET window.

*We have full staff and team in person/hybrid gatherings 1-2 times a year, but we respect that individuals have different risk levels with travel and will work with employees to determine what is possible, with consideration for what is unsafe or uncomfortable for team members.

COMPENSATION

This is a full-timenon-exempt position. Salary is $32.70/hr ($68,016 annualized).Fractured Atlas has fixed-tier compensation, so everyone at each tier makes the same. Learn more about our compensation structure here.

Benefits include employer-contributed dental, vision, medical insurance; flexible spending account; employer-contributed 401K plan; commuter benefits; professional development allowance; ticket and staff donation allowance for artist member projects; internet and cell-phone stipend; workplace supplies allowance; unlimited paid vacation days; paid sick days; paid family and medical leave; half-day Fridays (full time is 36 hours), and a casual but hard-working, friendly, and supportive work environment.Learn more about our benefits here.

TO APPLY

When submitting your application, you will be asked which role you are applying for and if you are open to and interested in being considered for both.

To be considered for the position, please use the application portal to upload all the items below in one PDF-formatted file:

  1. Answers to the following prompts (please keep responses to 200 words or less per prompt)
  • Tell us about a time you successfully helped someone achieve their goal(s).
  • What kind of work environment do you thrive in or enjoy contributing to?
  • What’s something in the fundraising or grant landscape that excites you right now? Please consider your top choice of the two roles as you decide (Grants & Member Advisor, Programs or Fundraising & Member Advisor, Programs).
  1. Resume no longer than (1) page
  2. A list of (3) professional references complete with phone number, email address, and explanation of the relationship. (References will not be contacted without your prior consent.)

If you're looking for a way to merge PDFs, iLovePDF is a free browser based option. Incomplete submissions will not be considered, nor will submissions sent outside of the application portal.

When applying, you can use any name that you’d like to be referred to—it does not need to be your legal name. If at any point in the process you’d like for us to update your name in our applicant tracking system, please email and we can update it for you.

We receive many applications for each job and cannot respond to questions about the position unless you are having a technical issue with the job portal or are requesting accommodations for the process. If you need help with a technical issue or are requesting accommodations, please email .

Want to know what’s next after you apply?Here is a breakdown of the steps of the hiring process. We have two or more staff members reviewing materials at each stage and we do not use AI screening tools. We use platforms to help manage the process (Spark Hire and JazzHR) but we do not use their AI screening add-ons.

You can learn more about Fractured Atlas by reviewing our website, blog, and .

OUR COMMITMENT

Fractured Atlas is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. (Read more about our Anti-Racism and Anti-Oppression commitment.) We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

POSTING DATE

October 7th, 2026. Deadline for submissions is October 21st, 2026 at 11:59 PM Pacific Time

raw.description:
Who we are: Yourgi is on a mission to become Earth's most trusted pet care connector, connecting pet parents with a reliable local network of certified professionals, pet resorts, and veterinary centers. Backed by a passionate team, our mission is to make pet care simple, accessible, and joyful for all. Because pets aren't just animals—they're family.

Yourgi's mission is to be pet parents' most trusted source for pet care services. We are building a differentiated experience for both pet parents and pros through our marketplace and software platform. Pet parents book grooming, boarding, daycare, and training, and independent pet-care pros run their businesses with Yourgi Pro, Connect, and Match. We also power booking for Destination Pet's own locations.

You'll build Yourgi's engineering services function from the ground up: DevOps, SRE, release engineering, infrastructure as code, data pipelines, security operations, and data governance. Your job is to make deploys boring, rollbacks instant, production visible, and data trustworthy. You'll lead a small team of DevOps and SRE engineers, some nearshore, stay hands-on, and set the operating practices every product team follows.

LOCATION : Remote (US only; must be authorized to work in the US, no visa sponsorship)

REPORTS TO: VP of Engineering

PAY: $190,000 base +10% bonus

CORE RESPONSIBILITES:

  • DevOps and release engineering: own CI/CD for API, web, and mobile (GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines), with unattended deploys, staged or canary releases, one-click rollback, and controlled production deploy access.
  • SRE: stand up production monitoring and alerting on AWS (CloudWatch, X-Ray, synthetics, and PagerDuty), define SLOs for critical customer journeys, and replace noisy alert channels with alerts that are actionable and owned.
  • Incident and change management: launch a shared on-call rotation, incident response, blameless postmortems, and weekly operational reviews.
  • Infrastructure as code: bring AWS infrastructure and database operations under code (OpenTofu, Terraform, or CDK), with consistent environments and reviewed changes.
  • Data pipelines: own the reliability of pipelines that move data from our services and partner systems into the data lake and warehouse, with monitoring, retries, and clear owners.
  • Security operations: run secrets management, least-privilege IAM, dependency and vulnerability scanning, and supply-chain hygiene in every pipeline.
  • Data governance: set standards for data access, retention, classification, and logging so customer data is handled safely across systems.
  • Measures and cost: report DORA metrics (deploy frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore) and make cloud cost visible by team and service.
  • People: hire, manage, and develop DevOps and SRE engineers, and help product teams own their services in production.

30/60/90 plan


First 30 Days: Inventory the existing pipelines, environments, AWS accounts, alerts, data pipelines, and production access permissions. Establish baseline monitoring for the most critical services. By the end of the first 30 days, review the current-state inventory and the key operational and security risks with the VP of Engineering, and ensure that baseline monitoring dashboards are live.


By Day 60: Establish and launch the on-call rotation and incident management process. Deliver at least one pipeline with automated deployment and rollback capabilities. Publish the initial standards for secrets management, access controls, and data handling. By day 60, ensure the on-call rotation is staffed, the first incident postmortems are documented, weekly operational dashboards are being reported, and the standards have been approved.


By Day 90: Define service-level objectives (SLOs) and configure alerts for the five most important customer journeys. Transition most production services into a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) process. Introduce a monthly report covering DORA metrics and cloud costs. By the end of 90 days, ensure that SLOs and paging alerts are operational for all five customer journeys, deliver the first DORA and cloud-cost report to leadership, and establish an agreed-upon team hiring plan.

What will you need?

Required skills and experience

  • 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers.
  • Deep AWS experience, especially serverless (Lambda, EventBridge, and API Gateway), IAM, and RDS.
  • Built CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, or similar, including automated rollback.
  • Infrastructure as code in production (Terraform, OpenTofu, or CDK).
  • Ran on-call and incident management that measurably reduced incidents and time to restore.
  • Hands-on security operations: secrets management, access control, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Comfortable managing nearshore or distributed team members.

Differentiators

  • Data pipeline and data governance experience (e.g., Snowflake, data lakes, or event pipelines).
  • Datadog or CloudWatch at scale; OpenTelemetry.
  • Mobile release pipelines (App Store and Google Play).
  • PCI awareness from working with payments (Stripe).
  • AI tools for operations, such as incident summarization and runbook automation.

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword Health is looking for a Marketing Manager to join our marketing team and lead the creation of the marketing materials that speak directly to our members. You will own how Sword shows up in front of members across our products and a wide mix of acquisition channels, including email, direct mail, toolkits, landing pages, and paid media. This role sits at the center of a cross-functional group of designers, clinicians, copywriters, and marketing operations partners, and is responsible for turning a deep understanding of member needs into content that drives engagement and enrollment. We are looking for a creative, data-driven, and member-centric marketer who can manage multiple channels at once, move quickly, and keep improving results over time.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the end-to-end creation of marketing materials for Sword Health members across our products and channels, including email, direct mailers, toolkits, paid media, and more
  • Translate member insights, needs, and motivations into clear, compelling messaging and creative concepts tailored to each product and population
  • Partner closely with design, clinical, copywriting, customer success, and marketing operations teams to brief, develop, review, and launch materials on time and to Sword’s quality and compliance standards
  • Own the planning and execution of campaigns and assets across channels, ensuring a consistent, best-in-class member experience
  • Analyze the main performance metrics of each channel (e.g., open and click rates, enrollment conversion, CPA, and engagement) and turn the findings into clear recommendations
  • Design and run tests (messaging, creative, audiences, formats) and apply the learnings to continuously improve performance
  • Work with clinical partners to make sure content is accurate, empathetic, and aligned with Sword’s clinical approach
  • Work with marketing operations on audience segmentation, targeting, and campaign deployment
  • Report on campaign and channel performance to internal stakeholders, and surface learnings that can scale across products and channels
  • Stay close to the member voice by using feedback, research, and data to shape future content and strategy

What you need to have

  • 3–5 years of experience in a marketing role, ideally in B2C, lifecycle, or growth marketing; digital health or B2B2C experience is a plus (but not required)
  • Experience creating and managing marketing materials across multiple channels (e.g., email, direct mail, paid media, and/or toolkits)
  • Ability to understand member needs and translate them into effective messaging and creative
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute multiple initiatives at once
  • Strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to read channel performance metrics, draw insights, and act on them
  • Experience working cross-functionally with design, copy, clinical, and/or operations teams to deliver projects on tight timelines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A member-centric and growth mindset, with the ability to empathize with our patients and their challenges
  • Creative and strategic thinking, with a willingness to test new ideas and push boundaries
  • Collaborative with team members within and across US and international locations
  • Experience and desire to work in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

What we would love to see (Optional)

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, or other regulated industries (e.g., familiarity with HIPAA and compliant member communications)
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation or CRM platforms and with paid media platforms
  • Experience with A/B and multivariate testing and a data-driven approach to optimization
  • Experience working with B2B2C models, where you market to end users on behalf of client organizations

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Director of Applied AI Engineering

North - Remote (US)


Let’s go North, together.


Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions.


Job Summary:

The Director of Applied AI Engineering will build and lead North's Applied AI team: a hands-on group that takes AI capabilities from prototype to production inside real business workflows. This is a delivery role, not a research role, measured by systems that are live, adopted, and safe to run in a regulated financial services environment. This will require an individual with strong software engineering fundamentals, judgment about where large language models and machine learning outperform conventional automation, attention to detail, and the capacity to rapidly develop and act upon in-depth knowledge of our business, products, customers, and regulatory obligations.


This position will partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Risk to improve current business processes, and will work with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Information Security to ensure AI systems are explainable, auditable, and safely governed. This role is responsible for providing updates to leadership on the team's impact through clear reporting and KPIs, and for establishing the long-term strategy, technical architecture, and responsible-AI guardrails as well as the short-term scope and sequencing that gets value into production quickly.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Build and lead a high-performing Applied AI engineering team, defining the practice's operating model, engagement strategy, and technical standards from the ground up.
  • Partner with Product, customers, and business stakeholders to observe workflows and turn operational challenges into effective AI solutions.
  • Drive rapid discovery, prototyping, and seamless transition of AI capabilities to production across concurrent enterprise projects.
  • Architect, deploy, and maintain production AI solutions, including agentic workflows, chatbots, copilots, agent-assist tools, and traditional ML models.
  • Establish modular, reusable integrations for AI agents to securely access internal systems and enterprise data with least-privilege controls.
  • Own the AI evaluation lifecycle, incorporating offline/online evals, benchmark datasets, human-in-the-loop validation, and production readiness criteria.
  • Manage production operations alongside Cloud and Data engineering, overseeing CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, latency, and inference cost optimization.

What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, or a related domain, including time in a customer-facing or business-embedded engineering capacity (ex. forward deployed, solutions, or professional services engineering)
  • 2+ years building and shipping production systems on top of large language models (LLMs), including at least one agentic or conversational system live with real users
  • 4+ years of hands-on management experience with a track record of hiring and growing teams as well as providing coaching and mentoring
  • Exceptional leadership skills, and proven ability to operate in a fast-moving environment
  • Hands-on approach to closing gaps in technical execution, able to personally debug a misbehaving agent in production

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and executive-level communication skills, bridging technical teams and leadership seamlessly.
  • Hands-on expertise in code-level AI SDKs and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AWS Strands Agents), selecting optimal tools rather than relying on no-code builders.
  • Knowledge of core building blocks of production AI applications: tool/function calling, RAG, vector search, structured outputs, conversation and state management, and the judgment to favor deterministic workflows when appropriate.
  • Cloud engineering skills (preferably AWS), including deploying agents on managed services (e.g., Bedrock AgentCore), containers, IAM, networking, and cost optimization.
  • Track record deploying and maintaining production AI systems, driving robust CI/CD, tracing, incident response, and latency/cost controls.
  • Experience making evaluation part of the build cycle, including test sets, regression testing, human review, and measuring quality once systems are live
  • Grasp of AI security and guardrails (prompt injection defense, least-privilege access, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop design) aligned with financial regulations (Model Risk Management, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA).

What we offer:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) + Match
  • Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Education Assistance
  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account

Salary Range: $207,000-290,000 USD

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.


Please note: North is a US-based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.

Who we are:

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.


Let’s go North, together! Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling.

Welcome to MICE DESK

﻿

MICE DESK is the leading European company automating the sales process in the hospitality industry — and we are now expanding to the US.

Our platform, Rocket, turns event, meeting, and group inquiries into autonomous end-to- end workflows: from RFP to signed contract, across email, CRM, and PMS systems. We integrate with the systems hotels actually run on — Oracle OPERA Cloud, SIHOT, Guestline, Salesforce, Marriott's enterprise stack — which means our engineers work inside real hotel operations, not against sandbox APIs.

We are a Series A-stage company with a deliberately small team and real enterprise traction: major hotel groups across Europe run their group sales on Rocket. The people joining now shape the product, the deployment playbook, and the culture.
﻿

﻿﻿

The Role

Product Owners are how Rocket turns product direction into successful execution. You own specific product domains within the platform, ensuring engineering teams have clear requirements, priorities, and context needed to deliver high-quality features.

This is not a strategy ownership role. You work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, QA, and customer-facing teams to translate product direction into actionable requirements, manage delivery, and ensure successful execution within your product area.

If you enjoy solving complex product problems, coordinating teams, and turning ideas into reliable software experiences, this is the role.

What You Will Own

1. Backlog ownership and delivery execution.

Own delivery for assigned product domains across the MICE DESK platform. Manage and refine the backlog, prioritize work based on guidance from the Product Manager, customer input, and business impact, and ensure engineering teams have everything required to deliver successful features.

2. Requirements and feature definition.

Translate product direction and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements for engineering teams. Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications while ensuring features are well understood before development begins.

3. Cross-functional collaboration.

Act as the connection point between Product, Engineering, Design, QA, and customer-facing teams throughout the development lifecycle. Support alignment on scope, priorities, delivery expectations, and successful feature releases.

4. Customer and product understanding.

Build a strong working understanding of customer workflows and operational pain points within your product domain. Support customer feedback collection, help validate solutions in partnership with the Product Manager, and provide insights that improve product execution.

5. Continuous improvement.

Improve product delivery through structured feedback, better processes, and execution-level insights. Surface opportunities for product enhancements to inform product strategy, support product discovery and experimentation led by the Product Manager, and contribute insights to long-term product planning.

What Success Looks Like

  • 3 months: You understand your assigned product domains, work effectively with Engineering and Product, and independently manage requirements, backlog refinement, and delivery processes.
  • 12 months: You own delivery across key product areas, engineering teams rely on your clarity and execution, and your work consistently improves feature delivery quality and customer outcomes.

    ﻿

    ﻿

Who You Are

Must-have
﻿

  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar role in a SaaS or software product environment
  • Proven experience managing product backlogs and supporting software delivery
  • Strong ability to translate customer and product needs into clear requirements
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications
  • Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Experience using product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Linear, or similar
  • Excellent English communication skills (B2–C1)
    ﻿

WHO ARE WE?

Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB

Reporting to the VP of Venue Network Services, the Director of Network Engineering provides strategic leadership and direction for design, development, delivery and maintenance of current and future technologies; addressing internal and external business needs for the Network Engineering teams. This role also leads the network infrastructure strategy, operations, and reliability for more than 150 live event venues across North America.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Ensure managed service partners are meeting established SLAs

  • Deliver converged, reliable, scalable, high-quality services to the business and venues including all network infrastructure, telecommunications and many other forms of venue technology including digital signage, CCTV and POD systems, etc.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • BA or BS degree in business, technology or another related field preferred.

  • Ability to travel approximately 10% of the time.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:


HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match


EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.


We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.


We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.


HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.


Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Live Nation may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

What sets us apart is our foundation as a hands-on, technically driven organization backed by deep industry partnerships and a broad portfolio of certifications – at both the company and individual levels. This combination of experience and credibility allows us to respond with confidence and precision to complex technical challenges.

Our greatest strength is our people. We are seasoned technologists who embrace a culture of innovation and continuous learning. We believe that meaningful solutions are built through collaboration, and we view every challenge as an opportunity to evolve – transforming problems into partnerships that deliver long-term value. This mindset shapes how we work: we hire top talent, provide them with the resources and mentorship they need to thrive, and recognize and reward excellence at every level. NFF is seeking staff augmentation resources for software development tasks that span the full operational scope of Metro. These contract positions support the development of applications in Microsoft Power Platform and Microsoft Azure, focused on process improvement for mission-critical processes, including public-facing service applications.

The engagement seeks professionals with demonstrated experience in the design, deployment, enhancement, and support of highly available, mission-critical applications serving public-facing and internal business functions, primarily on Microsoft Azure and Power Platform. Candidates must have expertise in the tools, governance frameworks, security practices, and delivery methodologies commonly employed by large enterprises to develop, integrate, and maintain complex business applications.

The initial scope includes enhancement, optimization, and enterprise integration of a public-facing notification platform that requires additional integration with key enterprise systems.   • 5 years of experience designing data-driven, cross-platform API models and developing data mappings and integrations for Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), customer relationship management (CRM) systems, and downstream data feeds.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart(R).


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Regulatory Strategist, Advertising & Promotion to join our team in a remote capacity. As a Senior Regulatory Strategist, Advertising & Promotion, you will serve as a trusted regulatory advisor supporting clinical research and commercial activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in ensuring regulatory compliance, interpreting FDA guidance, and delivering strategic regulatory insights that shape product strategy. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including Medical Affairs, Legal, Commercial, and Marketing, follow industry-standard regulatory processes, and contribute to regulatory excellence from strategy development through implementation. Responsibilities include providing strategic regulatory guidance on advertising and promotional materials, independently reviewing and approving promotional content, and interpreting evolving FDA guidance, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence regulatory strategy across the organization.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic regulatory leadership, risk mitigation, and advancing patient safety. raw.title: Patient Engagement Specialist (CareSync Coordinator)
raw.excerpt: Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services.
raw.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

Department: Patient Support Center – CareSync

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote | Hourly, Non-Exempt

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6:00 PM CT; flexibility to support new patient inbound coverage as needed.


Who We Are

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.


The Role

The Patient Engagement Specialist is a high-impact, outbound-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are the voice that reaches out to patients after they’ve been referred or expressed interest in care, helping them move from referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll process incoming referrals, make timely and persistent outreach, and deliver white-glove support to the referring providers who trust us with their patients. You’ll also flex to answer new patient inbound calls when volume calls for it.


This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and follow-through to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and keep referring partners informed every step of the way. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every outreach is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

Drive Outbound Engagement & Conversion

  • Proactively call referred patients and new patient leads, making first contact the same or next business day and following a structured outreach cadence until the patient is scheduled or the referral is closed.
  • Convert referrals and leads into scheduled first visits by matching each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools.
  • Guide hesitant patients toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks, and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
  • Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
  • Meet individual and team targets for speed to first outreach, contact rate, and referral-to-scheduled conversion.

Process Referrals Accurately

  • Receive, review, and process incoming referrals from email, fax, phone, and partner channels promptly and accurately.
  • Confirm patient demographic and insurance information is complete and accurate; follow up with the referring office or patient to close any gaps.
  • Track each referral from receipt to first visit so status is clear to referring partners and internal teams.
  • Build and maintain working knowledge of accepted insurance plans.

Deliver White-Glove Support to Referring Providers

  • Serve as a responsive, reliable point of contact for referring provider offices, answering questions and sharing timely referral status updates.
  • Close the loop with referring providers by confirming receipt, sharing scheduling outcomes, and letting them know when another level of care may be a better fit.
  • Build trusted relationships with key partner practices so Geode is an easy, dependable place to send their patients.

Flex to Support New Patient Inbound Calls

  • Answer new patient inbound calls during peak volume or as assigned, with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
  • Partner with the Patient Support Center team to keep handoffs seamless for patients and providers.

Grow Through Coaching & Quality

  • Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, outreach timeliness, contact rate, quality, and documentation, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
  • Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
  • Document every outreach attempt and interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step.

Own the Patient & Provider Experience

  • Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
  • Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
  • Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

Who You Are

  • A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
  • Energized by outbound outreach - comfortable making proactive calls and following up with persistence and care.
  • Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
  • A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
  • Organized and process-oriented - you track details closely and keep every referral moving.
  • Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

What You Bring

  • 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; experience in a medical office, mental health, referral coordination, outbound calling, or sales/conversion is a strong plus.
  • Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickly (preferred).
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple systems while maintaining a warm, focused conversation with the patient.
  • A quiet, professional remote workspace and reliable connectivity.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

At Geode Health, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible schedule

  • In-person and virtual patient visits

  • Comprehensive admin support (front office, accounting, finance, payroll, HR, etc)

  • Professional development opportunities

  • Clinical community, support, and leadership

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Life insurance

  • Short and long-term disability

  • Paid vacation and holidays

  • Matching 401k plan

  • State of the art technology

Why work for Geode Health?

At Geode Health, we take our commitment to patients and providers seriously. We focus every day on how to help patients across the United States get the best possible mental health care available. To achieve this, we focus on ensuring our providers have unmatched support and resources so that they can focus on providing great care. We are backed by KKR, a leading private equity firm with the experience and mission alignment to truly make an impact. Joining Geode Health will put you on the front-end of a rapidly growing movement to increase access and improve outcomes for mental health patients and providers across the nation.

To learn more, visit us as

Geode Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences of our workforce.

Estimated hourly pay range:

$20.00-$21.00

raw.title: Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer - Remote
raw.excerpt: FormativGroup is hiring an Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer to join a Financial Services technology organization that builds and maintains digital products for tax professionals.
raw.description:
FormativGroup is hiring an Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer to join a Financial Services technology organization that builds and maintains digital products for tax professionals. The team develops internal tools, financial dashboards, analytics, reporting solutions, and other technology that improves how client-serving professionals work.

This is a hands-on Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer role for an experienced technical lead who wants to step into people leadership without stepping away from delivery. You will serve as both the senior technical authority and the people leader: contributing code, setting technical direction, reviewing work, strengthening engineering practices, and helping the team use AI agents effectively across the software development lifecycle. The environment includes legacy .NET/C# services and Angular front ends alongside newer Python, Node.js, and React development. You will help modernize the stack in phases while keeping business-critical components stable.

What You'll Work On

  • Lead from the keyboard: contribute production code regularly, use AI agents as part of day-to-day delivery, and stay close to the technical work.
  • Own the team’s technical direction, architecture decisions, long-term technical health, and roadmap across new delivery, modernization, and technical debt.
  • Lead phased modernization of legacy .NET/C# and Angular components while building new capabilities with Python, Node.js, and React.
  • Break work into small, well-bounded tasks and route each task to the best executor - an engineer, an agent, or yourself - while keeping coordination lean and outcome-focused.
  • Own pull request review and provide fast, technically substantive feedback.
  • Build and manage the technical-debt backlog, resolving priority issues directly instead of relying only on delegation.
  • Hire, evaluate, coach, and grow engineers; set the technical hiring bar and help the team work effectively with AI agents.
  • Create and maintain agent operating instructions, verification protocols, and human-in-the-loop controls for code, tests, documentation, and infrastructure changes.
  • Run evaluation checks before merge and retain human-owned merge control for production branches.
  • Maintain strong automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and uphold consistent engineering practices across design, coding, testing, release, and operations.
  • Drive CI/CD automation, containerized delivery, and Infrastructure as Code for cloud-native applications.
  • Track engineering health and delivery metrics, including required reporting through Atlassian Compass.
  • Facilitate bi-weekly live demos from the cloud environment, including both product features and agent-enabled workflows.
  • Partner with the dedicated production support organization by providing tooling, automation, documentation, and runbooks that make the product easier to operate and support.
  • Reduce operational toil through automation while applying appropriate security guardrails, blast-radius limits, and audit trails to production-touching workflows.
  • Maintain visibility into WIZ Critical and Major findings and drive remediation within required service levels.
  • Keep architecture documentation, ADRs, runbooks, and agent instructions current and usable.

What You'll Bring

  • 5-7+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with clear experience as a senior engineer or technical lead and prior leadership of at least one engineering team.
  • Hands-on full-stack development depth and the desire to continue building while managing engineers.
  • Strong proficiency with Python, Node.js, and React for modern application development.
  • Experience maintaining and modernizing .NET/C# services and Angular front ends.
  • Demonstrated use of agentic or AI-assisted software development workflows in real delivery environments, not just experimentation.
  • Ownership of the full development lifecycle: build, test, release, operate, troubleshoot, and iterate.
  • Cloud-native application experience on Azure; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.
  • Hands-on experience with containerized workloads and orchestration.
  • Infrastructure as Code experience with tools such as Bicep, Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK.
  • Strong automated testing and CI/CD experience across full-stack delivery.
  • Ability to make significant technical contributions, solve complex engineering problems, and make sound architecture decisions.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

How You Work

  • You are a player-coach: comfortable owning people leadership while remaining an active practitioner.
  • You use AI agents to increase engineering throughput, but you keep quality, testing, security, and production decisions under clear human control.
  • You bring structure without creating unnecessary process and identify technical dependencies, delivery risks, and quality issues early.
  • You are comfortable working in a small-team environment where priorities can shift and where leadership means doing the work as well as directing it.
  • You balance modernization with stability and understand that business-critical systems must continue to perform while the architecture evolves.

Additional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required.
  • Exposure to financial services, accounting, finance, tax technology, finance transformation, tax software development, or implementation environments.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned work through completion, including requirements, configuration, testing, debugging, and system/process changes.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Relevant professional certifications or advanced degrees - such as CPA, EA, JD, or a master's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, information systems, engineering, quantitative economics, or a related field - are a plus, but not required.
  • Familiarity with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Atlassian tools, SonarQube, Mend, Aqua Trivy, and WIZ.
  • Experience with micro front-end architectures.
  • Experience modernizing mixed legacy/new technology environments while continuing to ship.
  • Experience building practical engineering guardrails for AI-assisted or agentic development.

What Success Looks Like

  • The team ships predictably while maintaining strong quality, testing, security, and release discipline.
  • The Engineering Manager remains technically credible and materially contributes to delivery rather than operating only as a coordinator.
  • Legacy components remain stable while modernization progresses in deliberate, low-risk increments.
  • AI agents are used productively with clear verification, human review, and production controls.
  • Engineers receive timely technical feedback, coaching, and clear expectations, and the team’s technical hiring bar remains high.
  • Operational support improves through better automation, runbooks, documentation, and reduced manual toil.

Why Join FormativGroup

At FormativGroup, you'll work with people who are practical, collabroative, and focused on solving meaningful business and technology problems. We're growing, which means you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, work closely with experienced leaders, and help shape how we deliver for our clients.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa currently.

To be considered for this position, candidates must reside in one of the following U.S. states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WI, and Washington DC.Candidates residing outside these states are not eligible for consideration currently.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency. The compensation range for this position represents our good faith estimate of the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, education, work location, and internal equity.

In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses, commissions, or other incentive programs, as well as a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, etc.

Estimated Compensation Range:
$190,000—$210,000 USD

FormativGroup operates within the critical middle layer of business technology, where applications and systems connect infrastructure to business processes. We are specialists who help the middle market take full advantage of their technology investments with deep, industry-centric expertise, all in one place, to unify fragmented systems. With deep technical expertise across cloud architecture, system integration, AI, and data strategy, we bridge the gap between business goals and modern platforms.

FormativGroup is an equal opportunity employer providing opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
