You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and follow-through to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and keep referring partners informed every step of the way. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every outreach is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

Drive Outbound Engagement & Conversion

  • Proactively call referred patients and new patient leads, making first contact the same or next business day and following a structured outreach cadence until the patient is scheduled or the referral is closed.
  • Convert referrals and leads into scheduled first visits by matching each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools.
  • Guide hesitant patients toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks, and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
  • Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
  • Meet individual and team targets for speed to first outreach, contact rate, and referral-to-scheduled conversion.

Process Referrals Accurately

  • Receive, review, and process incoming referrals from email, fax, phone, and partner channels promptly and accurately.
  • Confirm patient demographic and insurance information is complete and accurate; follow up with the referring office or patient to close any gaps.
  • Track each referral from receipt to first visit so status is clear to referring partners and internal teams.
  • Build and maintain working knowledge of accepted insurance plans.

Deliver White-Glove Support to Referring Providers

  • Serve as a responsive, reliable point of contact for referring provider offices, answering questions and sharing timely referral status updates.
  • Close the loop with referring providers by confirming receipt, sharing scheduling outcomes, and letting them know when another level of care may be a better fit.
  • Build trusted relationships with key partner practices so Geode is an easy, dependable place to send their patients.

Flex to Support New Patient Inbound Calls

  • Answer new patient inbound calls during peak volume or as assigned, with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
  • Partner with the Patient Support Center team to keep handoffs seamless for patients and providers.

Grow Through Coaching & Quality

  • Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, outreach timeliness, contact rate, quality, and documentation, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
  • Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
  • Document every outreach attempt and interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step.

Own the Patient & Provider Experience

  • Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
  • Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
  • Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

Who You Are

  • A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
  • Energized by outbound outreach - comfortable making proactive calls and following up with persistence and care.
  • Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
  • A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
  • Organized and process-oriented - you track details closely and keep every referral moving.
  • Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

What You Bring

  • 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; experience in a medical office, mental health, referral coordination, outbound calling, or sales/conversion is a strong plus.
  • Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickly (preferred).
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple systems while maintaining a warm, focused conversation with the patient.
  • A quiet, professional remote workspace and reliable connectivity.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

At Geode Health, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible schedule

  • In-person and virtual patient visits

  • Comprehensive admin support (front office, accounting, finance, payroll, HR, etc)

  • Professional development opportunities

  • Clinical community, support, and leadership

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Life insurance

  • Short and long-term disability

  • Paid vacation and holidays

  • Matching 401k plan

  • State of the art technology

Why work for Geode Health?

At Geode Health, we take our commitment to patients and providers seriously. We focus every day on how to help patients across the United States get the best possible mental health care available. To achieve this, we focus on ensuring our providers have unmatched support and resources so that they can focus on providing great care. We are backed by KKR, a leading private equity firm with the experience and mission alignment to truly make an impact. Joining Geode Health will put you on the front-end of a rapidly growing movement to increase access and improve outcomes for mental health patients and providers across the nation.

To learn more, visit us as

raw.description:
FormativGroup is hiring an Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer to join a Financial Services technology organization that builds and maintains digital products for tax professionals. The team develops internal tools, financial dashboards, analytics, reporting solutions, and other technology that improves how client-serving professionals work.

This is a hands-on Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer role for an experienced technical lead who wants to step into people leadership without stepping away from delivery. You will serve as both the senior technical authority and the people leader: contributing code, setting technical direction, reviewing work, strengthening engineering practices, and helping the team use AI agents effectively across the software development lifecycle. The environment includes legacy .NET/C# services and Angular front ends alongside newer Python, Node.js, and React development. You will help modernize the stack in phases while keeping business-critical components stable.

What You'll Work On

  • Lead from the keyboard: contribute production code regularly, use AI agents as part of day-to-day delivery, and stay close to the technical work.
  • Own the team’s technical direction, architecture decisions, long-term technical health, and roadmap across new delivery, modernization, and technical debt.
  • Lead phased modernization of legacy .NET/C# and Angular components while building new capabilities with Python, Node.js, and React.
  • Break work into small, well-bounded tasks and route each task to the best executor - an engineer, an agent, or yourself - while keeping coordination lean and outcome-focused.
  • Own pull request review and provide fast, technically substantive feedback.
  • Build and manage the technical-debt backlog, resolving priority issues directly instead of relying only on delegation.
  • Hire, evaluate, coach, and grow engineers; set the technical hiring bar and help the team work effectively with AI agents.
  • Create and maintain agent operating instructions, verification protocols, and human-in-the-loop controls for code, tests, documentation, and infrastructure changes.
  • Run evaluation checks before merge and retain human-owned merge control for production branches.
  • Maintain strong automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and uphold consistent engineering practices across design, coding, testing, release, and operations.
  • Drive CI/CD automation, containerized delivery, and Infrastructure as Code for cloud-native applications.
  • Track engineering health and delivery metrics, including required reporting through Atlassian Compass.
  • Facilitate bi-weekly live demos from the cloud environment, including both product features and agent-enabled workflows.
  • Partner with the dedicated production support organization by providing tooling, automation, documentation, and runbooks that make the product easier to operate and support.
  • Reduce operational toil through automation while applying appropriate security guardrails, blast-radius limits, and audit trails to production-touching workflows.
  • Maintain visibility into WIZ Critical and Major findings and drive remediation within required service levels.
  • Keep architecture documentation, ADRs, runbooks, and agent instructions current and usable.

What You'll Bring

  • 5-7+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with clear experience as a senior engineer or technical lead and prior leadership of at least one engineering team.
  • Hands-on full-stack development depth and the desire to continue building while managing engineers.
  • Strong proficiency with Python, Node.js, and React for modern application development.
  • Experience maintaining and modernizing .NET/C# services and Angular front ends.
  • Demonstrated use of agentic or AI-assisted software development workflows in real delivery environments, not just experimentation.
  • Ownership of the full development lifecycle: build, test, release, operate, troubleshoot, and iterate.
  • Cloud-native application experience on Azure; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.
  • Hands-on experience with containerized workloads and orchestration.
  • Infrastructure as Code experience with tools such as Bicep, Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK.
  • Strong automated testing and CI/CD experience across full-stack delivery.
  • Ability to make significant technical contributions, solve complex engineering problems, and make sound architecture decisions.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

How You Work

  • You are a player-coach: comfortable owning people leadership while remaining an active practitioner.
  • You use AI agents to increase engineering throughput, but you keep quality, testing, security, and production decisions under clear human control.
  • You bring structure without creating unnecessary process and identify technical dependencies, delivery risks, and quality issues early.
  • You are comfortable working in a small-team environment where priorities can shift and where leadership means doing the work as well as directing it.
  • You balance modernization with stability and understand that business-critical systems must continue to perform while the architecture evolves.

Additional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required.
  • Exposure to financial services, accounting, finance, tax technology, finance transformation, tax software development, or implementation environments.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned work through completion, including requirements, configuration, testing, debugging, and system/process changes.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Relevant professional certifications or advanced degrees - such as CPA, EA, JD, or a master's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, information systems, engineering, quantitative economics, or a related field - are a plus, but not required.
  • Familiarity with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Atlassian tools, SonarQube, Mend, Aqua Trivy, and WIZ.
  • Experience with micro front-end architectures.
  • Experience modernizing mixed legacy/new technology environments while continuing to ship.
  • Experience building practical engineering guardrails for AI-assisted or agentic development.

What Success Looks Like

  • The team ships predictably while maintaining strong quality, testing, security, and release discipline.
  • The Engineering Manager remains technically credible and materially contributes to delivery rather than operating only as a coordinator.
  • Legacy components remain stable while modernization progresses in deliberate, low-risk increments.
  • AI agents are used productively with clear verification, human review, and production controls.
  • Engineers receive timely technical feedback, coaching, and clear expectations, and the team’s technical hiring bar remains high.
  • Operational support improves through better automation, runbooks, documentation, and reduced manual toil.

Why Join FormativGroup

At FormativGroup, you'll work with people who are practical, collabroative, and focused on solving meaningful business and technology problems. We're growing, which means you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, work closely with experienced leaders, and help shape how we deliver for our clients.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa currently.

To be considered for this position, candidates must reside in one of the following U.S. states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WI, and Washington DC.Candidates residing outside these states are not eligible for consideration currently.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency. The compensation range for this position represents our good faith estimate of the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, education, work location, and internal equity.

In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses, commissions, or other incentive programs, as well as a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, etc.

$190,000—$210,000 USD

We are specialists who help the middle market take full advantage of their technology investments with deep, industry-centric expertise, all in one place, to unify fragmented systems. With deep technical expertise across cloud architecture, system integration, AI, and data strategy, we bridge the gap between business goals and modern platforms.

Responsibilities

Peraton Labs is seeking a Senior DevSecOps / Platform Engineer to own the Agentic AI platform end-to-end across delivery, infrastructure, runtime operations, and platform health. This role will be responsible for building and operating the technical backbone that enables secure, reliable, and scalable platform delivery, from CI/CD pipelines and automated testing through EKS cluster operations, AWS infrastructure, monitoring, alerting, and synthetic health checking. The ideal candidate combines deep technical execution with strong operational judgment and a builder mindset, with the ability to design systems that are not only functional, but supportable, observable, secure, and audit-ready.

This is an opportunity to own the platform layer of a highly visible and ambitious Agentic AI environment. You will work on meaningful problems that require strong technical judgment, operational rigor, and modern engineering practices. For the right candidate, this role offers the chance to build real systems, improve platform resilience, and directly influence how advanced AI-enabled capabilities are delivered in secure, compliant, and production-ready ways.

Key responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Own and operate the Agentic AI platform end-to-end across CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes operations, observability, and runtime reliability
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines across GitHub Actions and/or GitLab CI, enabling secure, repeatable, and efficient delivery workflows
  • Implement and improve automated testing and quality gates within the software delivery lifecycle, including build validation, integration checks, security testing, and deployment controls
  • Lead operational ownership of Amazon EKS / Kubernetes environments, including cluster lifecycle management, upgrades, troubleshooting, RBAC, Helm-based deployments, pod identity, and GitOps-aligned workflows
  • Build and maintain AWS infrastructure supporting platform and application needs across services such as VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudTrail, and KMS
  • Own infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management through OpenTofu / Terraform and related infrastructure-as-code practices
  • Design and operate a mature monitoring, logging, and alerting stack using CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent tooling
  • Develop actionable alerts, service health indicators, and SLO-aligned operational thresholds that support fast triage and resilient service delivery
  • Build and maintain synthetic and transactional monitoring that exercises real authentication flows, user journeys, and critical service transactions
  • Implement and maintain DAST and runtime security testing in delivery pipelines using tools such as OWASP ZAP, Burp, Nuclei, or equivalent
  • Support security-focused CI/CD practices including secrets management, least privilege, software supply chain integrity, and audit evidence generation
  • Drive modern engineering delivery patterns such as trunk-based development, merge-request-driven change, and automated release quality controls

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of BS with 8+ years of experience, MS with 6+ YoE, or PhD with 3+ YoE in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or closely related infrastructure engineering roles
  • Deep CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and/or GitLab CI
  • Strong hands-on background operating Amazon EKS / Kubernetes environments
  • Senior-level AWS experience across core services including VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudTrail, and KMS
  • Strong experience building and operating monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions at scale using CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent
  • Hands-on infrastructure-as-code experience using OpenTofu / Terraform
  • Experience supporting agile delivery models, including trunk-based development, MR-driven change, and automated quality gates
  • Strong security and compliance engineering foundation, including secrets management, least privilege, supply chain integrity, and audit evidence support
  • Experience implementing automated testing in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience running DAST and security testing against live services in pipeline workflows, including triage and gating of findings alongside SAST/SCA results
  • Experience building synthetic and transactional monitoring, including scripted health checks that validate real auth flows and critical transactions
  • Strong troubleshooting, systems thinking, and operational ownership mindset
  • US Citizenship is a requirement for this position

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing BigBang / Platform One
  • Familiarity with Iron Bank, Sigstore/Cosign, and hardened image pipeline practices
  • Prior experience supporting systems pursuing or maintain an ATO
  • Experience with contract testing such as PACT
  • Experience with chaos engineering concepts or tooling
  • Experience with progressive delivery approaches such as canary or blue/green deployments with automated rollback based on health-check failure
  • Experience working in regulated or mission environments aligned to NIST 800-171, CMMC, FedRAMP, or DoD security expectations
  • Background helping mature platform reliability and security in cloud-native environments supporting sensitive workloads

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Job Description

A bit about this role:


Devoted Health is seeking a strategic, influential leader with a strong operational track record to serve as Director of Provider Escalations & Education. This role is designed for an operator who can effectively de-escalate issues with our most critical provider partners, build processes that make our escalation response more scalable and effective, and drive cross-functional initiatives that prevent escalations in the first place.

Reporting directly to the Head of Provider Escalations & Education, you will work closely with cross-functional partners to build tooling that helps us diagnose escalation issues quickly and at scale, prepare executive briefings that equip leadership to decide on next steps, and charter initiatives that address the root causes of escalations through improvements to our operational processes and policies.

The best candidate will combine operational excellence, systems thinking, obsession with detail, pace-setting execution, and the ability to create confidence through change. This role is ideal for someone who organizes around metrics and outcomes, runs to hard problems, has a strong track record of achieving results, and thrives in ambiguity while building durable systems that outlast any one leader.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Ownership of Devoted’s Health System Escalation function, including escalation response time, quality, and time to resolution
  • Influential Leadership: Drive alignment and change across a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, including Devoted’s executive team, Network, Claims, Payment Integrity, Clinical, Product, and Engineering teams, to achieve goals
  • Managing the function through rigorous metrics, KPIs, scorecards, and performance dashboards, with clear accountability for outcomes
  • Leading through significant evolution while creating confidence, momentum, stability, and strong culture through change
  • Running the current operation while designing, implementing, and owning the future-state process
  • Raising the talent bar across the organization by setting the pace and modeling high standards
  • Building and operationalizing AI-enabled and human-in-the-loop workflows that improve quality, and speed of our response resolution
  • Establishing clear visibility into units of work, productivity, quality, cost, workforce planning, and performance metrics
  • Defining and executing the roadmap for scaling our Health System Escalations function through workflow automation, and self-service

Required skills and experience:

  • At least 10 years of leadership experience with a track record of delivering measurable outcomes in complex operational environments
  • Outstanding operational rigor with the ability to deploy technology to solve complex business challenges
  • Proven experience driving end-to-end initiatives from strategy through execution that materially improve quality, service levels, cost, compliance, or operational efficiency
  • Strong systems thinking and product mindset, with experience owning roadmaps, KPIs, and cross-functional execution
  • Demonstrated ability to manage through metrics, establish ambitious targets, and drive teams to results with clear accountability
  • Exceptional attention to detail and precision, with a reputation for sweating the details and getting the hardest operational last mile right
  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to lead through managers, distributed teams, and external vendors
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners
  • Clear evidence of urgency, resilience, and the ability to move quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Demonstrated ability to raise the talent bar and serve as a pace setter for teams and peers

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience transforming operations through AI-enabled workflows




Salary Range: $182,000-$216,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Position summary

The National Account Manager, Market Access Employer Engagement, is a strategic, external-facing member of US Market Access. Reporting to the Director, Employer Engagement - Obesity, this role leads engagement with a defined portfolio of jumbo employers and the organizations that shape their health-benefit decisions, including employer benefit consultants, coalitions, TPAs, PBMs, carriers, point-solution partners and, where relevant, IDNs. The Account Manager helps customers navigate evidence-based approaches to obesity and other Amgen therapeutic areas as assigned, with the goal of enabling appropriate patient access, sustainable benefit design and improved population-health outcomes.

This role combines consultative account leadership with deep market access expertise. The Account Manager develops account strategies, uncovers customer needs and market barriers, coordinates compliant Amgen resources, and translates field insight into enterprise strategy, evidence generation, tools and launch readiness. Success is measured by the quality and strategic depth of customer engagement, access progress within priority accounts, actionable insight and cross-functional impact - not by traditional sales call activity alone.


Key responsibilities

Own a strategic regional portfolio of priority jumbo employers and employer ecosystem accounts; create and execute account plans that define customer objectives, stakeholder maps, access barriers, value exchange, actions, measures and escalation needs.

Build trusted, senior-level relationships with employer benefits, total rewards, pharmacy, medical, finance and procurement leaders, as well as EBCs, consultants, coalition leaders, TPAs, PBMs, carriers and appropriate point-solution partners.

Lead consultative discussions on obesity benefit design, access and affordability, utilization-management approaches, patient journey and population-health outcomes, within approved Amgen strategy and compliant engagement models.

Identify and advance appropriate access opportunities through the employer decision ecosystem; coordinate with internal market access strategy, contracting, brand, medical, HEOR/RWE, value communications, patient support and field teams.

Translate Amgen clinical, economic and real-world evidence into customer-relevant value discussions; identify evidence gaps and bring actionable needs to HEOR/RWE and strategy partners.

Develop scalable employer-facing capabilities, including account tools, meeting-in-a-box content, market insights and solution concepts that support launch readiness and sustained engagement.

Monitor and communicate employer benefit, PBM, vendor, policy and competitive trends. Deliver concise, decision-ready insights that inform segmentation, account prioritization, contracting, evidence generation and brand strategy.

Represent Amgen at employer, consultant and coalition meetings and selected industry forums; expand the organization’s external presence and credibility in the employer market.

Maintain rigorous account documentation, CRM hygiene, performance tracking and compliance with all legal, regulatory, privacy and company requirements.

Conduct field sales support as necessary to drive pull through of coverage opportunities and resolve billing and coding issues related to Amgen products


Basic qualifications

· Doctorate degree and 2 years of sales, marketing, market access, employer benefits or payer experience; OR Master’s degree and 4 years; OR Bachelor’s degree and 6 years; OR Associate’s degree and 10 years; OR High school diploma or GED and 12 years of relevant experience.

· Three or more years of customer-facing strategic account management, market access, payer, employer-benefits, consulting, PBM, health-plan, coalition or relevant healthcare experience.

· Ability to travel domestically up to 60 percent of the time, including overnight travel, as business needs require.


Preferred qualifications

· Direct experience with self-insured jumbo employers, employer benefit consultants, employer coalitions, TPAs, PBMs, carriers or health-benefit point solutions.

·Demonstrated ability to influence access, coverage, benefit design, affordability or population-health decisions in a complex healthcare ecosystem.

· Strong knowledge of employer-sponsored benefits, pharmacy and medical benefit management, utilization management, managed care and contracting concepts.

·Experience in obesity, cardiometabolic disease, chronic-condition management, population health, value-based care or another complex therapeutic area.

· Ability to interpret and communicate clinical, HEOR/RWE, claims or utilization data in an executive-level, customer-relevant manner.

·Proven cross-functional leadership without direct authority, strong executive presentation skills and disciplined account-planning execution.

·MBA, PharmD, MPH or other advanced degree preferred.


Critical success profile

The ideal candidate is commercially rigorous and customer-centered: able to hold an informed conversation about affordability without reducing the relationship to price, elevate evidence without becoming academic, and coordinate the right Amgen resources without overpromising. They create value before a coverage decision, use insight to shape the enterprise, and bring disciplined follow-through to a complex, long-cycle employer market.


What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

raw.description:
About the role

We're looking for a fractional Video Director to own our video program from strategy through production to quality.

Video has become one of our fastest-growing services. We have more than 100 videos in production across clients right now. Our current setup of agencies, freelancers and an overstretched producer isn't scaling on quality or cost. You'll fix that. That means sourcing the right partners, setting the quality bar, building the workflow, and standing behind the work with clients.

The work doesn't look like a traditional brand shoot. Our videos are built to be found and cited. That means YouTube videos, social-friendly clips, expert interviews and explainers that answer the questions buyers ask AI. Clarity and usefulness matter more than production polish.

About Foundation

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when buyers ask AI for solutions. We do the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence where AI and buyers look: LLMs, search, Reddit and YouTube. We work with B2B brands across SaaS, HR and payroll tech, financial services, insurance and higher education.

YouTube is one of the sources AI tools regularly cite. Video done well makes our clients more likely to show up in the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own video quality standards and the QA process across every video we ship, from script to final cut.
  • Source, vet and manage video vendors and freelancers (editors, scriptwriters, creators). Hold them to quality, turnaround and cost.
  • Build a repeatable production workflow, including in-house editing and scriptwriting where it beats outsourcing on quality or cost.
  • Track cost per video and keep the program inside budget.
  • Coach our creative producer and video strategists on production, feedback and client handling.
  • Be the expert in the room with clients. Explain why a video is built for discovery, and push back on feedback that would hurt performance (talent choice, length, format).
  • Test AI-assisted editing and scripting tools, and adopt the ones that hold up to our quality bar.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in video or film production, including creative director or senior producer roles.
  • Experience running video at volume across multiple vendors and freelancers.
  • A working knowledge of YouTube: titles, hooks, retention, search and how videos get discovered.
  • Confidence with clients. You can defend a creative call to a senior marketer and keep the relationship strong.
  • A practical take on AI video tools. You know where they save time and where they fall short.
  • Comfort working fractionally: async-first, decisive, and focused on the highest-leverage problems.

First 90 days

  • A video QA checklist and review process used on every video before it ships.
  • A vendor audit covering quality, cost per video and turnaround, with a recommendation for each vendor.
  • A documented production workflow from brief to publish, including the in-house editing and scripting pilots.
  • A cost-per-video baseline and target, agreed with leadership.

How we'll measure success

  • Fewer revision rounds and faster turnaround from brief to publish.
  • Cost per video at or under target.
  • Video budget held as a percentage of revenue.
  • Client satisfaction on video deliverables, and fewer escalations about video.

Compensation

  • Hourly rate: $45–$65 depending on experience and location

Somos uma empresa multinacional brasileira, referência global no desenvolvimento de soluções sustentáveis e inovadoras, de origem renovável. Cultivamos árvores e, por meio de tecnologia, transformamos o que vem da natureza em produtos que fazem parte do dia a dia de milhões de pessoas.

As árvores estão no centro do nosso propósito: renovar a vida a partir da árvore e construir um futuro cada vez mais sustentável para o planeta e para as pessoas.

Temos mais de 100 anos de história, e hoje, somos a maior fabricante de celulose do mundo, uma das maiores produtoras de papéis da América Latina e líder no segmento de papel higiênico no Brasil. Nossos produtos estão no dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas, em mais de 100 países.

Estamos presentes em diferentes momentos com produtos como papel higiênico, guardanapos, papéis para imprimir e escrever, papéis para embalagens, copos e canudos, feitos a partir de matéria-prima de fonte renovável.

Você pode nos reconhecer por marcas como Neve®, Pólen®, Suzano Report® e Mimmo®, entre outras. Quanto às unidades, estamos no Brasil e também em países como Argentina, Áustria, China, Coreia do Sul, Equador, Estados Unidos, Holanda, Israel e Singapura, com unidades administrativas e operacionais.

Juntos, trabalhamos diariamente para plantar um futuro melhor para o planeta e para as pessoas. Fazemos isso criando produtos sustentáveis a partir do cultivo do eucalipto, que é plantado e colhido por nós.

raw.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About the Role

Forbes Advisor is scaling its Comparison business, and we’re looking for a Digital Experience Lead to help drive its next stage of growth. This is a hands-on role focused on improving conversion across our landing pages and customer journeys.

Our Comparison business connects customers with the right products across a panel of partners, earning revenue by sending high-intent, well-matched customers their way. With significant investment across paid acquisition, getting the experience right from the moment a customer lands with us is critical.

You’ll work closely with SEM, Product, Engineering, Design and Data to understand customer behaviour, identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into experiments and improvements that drive measurable commercial impact.

The person we’re looking for is curious, commercially minded and obsessed with understanding what makes customers convert. You’ll be equally comfortable digging into performance data, developing a hypothesis, shaping a new experience and getting an experiment live.

Responsibilities:

Conversion & experimentation

  • Own the optimisation roadmap across your areas of the Comparison business, prioritising the biggest opportunities to improve conversion.
  • Continually optimise landing pages and customer journeys, using performance data and customer insight to identify and remove friction.
  • Turn opportunities into clear hypotheses and own experiments end-to-end – from test design and success measures through to execution, analysis and recommendations.
  • Balance quick wins with bigger ideas that could materially change performance, turning successful experiments into scalable improvements.

SEM & landing page performance

  • Work hand-in-hand with SEM to connect acquisition strategy with the on-site experience, maximising conversion and value from paid traffic.
  • Understand differences in customer intent, keywords, campaigns and traffic sources, and use those insights to shape landing page experiences.
  • Look across the full funnel to ensure optimisation drives meaningful commercial outcomes, not individual metrics in isolation.

Cross-functional delivery

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Design to identify opportunities and take experiments and experience improvements from idea through to launch.
  • Work with Data to ensure the right tracking and measurement are in place to make confident decisions.
  • Clearly communicate results, learnings and recommendations to stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years' experience in conversion rate optimisation, digital experience, growth or a similar optimisation-focused role.
  • Proven experience improving landing pages, funnels and digital customer journeys through experimentation.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing, from hypothesis development and test design through to analysis and decision-making.
  • Commercially sharp and able to connect customer behaviour and conversion to revenue and wider business performance.
  • Data-driven and curious, with the ability to spot opportunities and turn insight into action.
  • Strong understanding of UX and conversion best practices.
  • Experience with analytics and experimentation platforms such as GA4, Optimizely or similar.
  • A proactive self-starter, comfortable working across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Design and Data to get things done.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience optimising landing pages for SEM or other paid acquisition channels.
  • Experience within comparison, lead generation, affiliate or another performance-driven digital business in Home Improvement, Small Medium Business or similar.
  • Experience with user testing, session replay, heatmaps or other qualitative research methods.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Tableau or similar analytics tools.

The Agent Software & Advertising (ASA) organization at Zillow helps real estate professionals grow their business through marketing, sales, and productivity solutions, including our Zillow Pro platform and Premier Agent buyer leads. Working alongside cross-functional partners and the wider enablement team, the Sales Enablement Manager translates core business objectives into clearly defined and seamlessly executed enablement programs. This role manages the operational lifecycle of enablement programs—from scoping and stakeholder alignment through to execution—ensuring initiatives proceed smoothly while staying on track to meet established goals and outcomes. This is a highly collaborative role that bridges enablement, cross-functional partners, and agent teams, requiring strong organizational skills, clear communication, and a genuine curiosity about what makes sales and success teams perform.


You Will Get To:

  • Manage enablement initiatives from scoping through execution, capturing requirements, building timelines, and keeping cross-functional stakeholders aligned throughout
  • Partner with enablement specialists across content, product, and learning to scope, sequence, and deliver programs that serve Sales and Customer Success audiences across all segments

Who you are

  • Clear, confident communicator — comfortable adapting your style for different audiences including senior managers, cross-functional partners, and frontline teams
  • Ability to facilitate training and lead presentations in front of small and large audiences across different revenue teams
  • Clear, confident communicator — comfortable adapting your style for different audiences including senior leaders, cross-functional partners, and frontline teams
  • Solutions-oriented with the ability to identify problems, probe areas of ambiguity, and move work forward without waiting for complete direction
  • Collaborative by nature — able to build trust across teams, navigate competing priorities, and hold stakeholders accountable without formal authority
  • Ability to use data and program feedback to assess initiative effectiveness and recommend improvements
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and proactively creating structure where it doesn't yet exist

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exposure to structured sales frameworks (e.g., Challenger, Command of the Message)

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.

Data Engineer | About You

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing modern cloud-based data solutions that support analytics, reporting, and business intelligence initiatives. You will leverage your expertise in Azure, Python, SQL, and modern data platforms to develop scalable data pipelines, integrate data from multiple sources, and ensure the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise data ecosystems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with experience in cloud-native architectures, data transformation, and modern analytics platforms, including Microsoft Fabric.

Data Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and data integration processes to support enterprise reporting and analytics needs.
  • Build and optimize data transformation solutions using Python and SQL, ensuring efficient processing of large and complex datasets.
  • Integrate data from multiple internal and external sources while maintaining data quality, consistency, lineage, and reliability across the data platform.
  • Develop and support cloud-based data solutions within Azure, leveraging modern data services and best practices for scalability and performance.
  • Contribute to data platform modernization initiatives, including the implementation and adoption of Microsoft Fabric and Lakehouse architectures.
  • Collaborate with architects, analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to deliver trusted, business-ready data solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Optimize data models, storage layers, and query performance to support high-volume analytics and reporting workloads.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline, integration, and platform-related issues while implementing monitoring, governance, security, and compliance standards.

Data Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, including the design, development, and support of enterprise data platforms and data integration solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience developing complex transformations, data models, performance optimizations, and large-scale data processing solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Azure Storage, Databricks, or related cloud technologies.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and cloud-based analytics environments supporting reporting and business intelligence initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, governance, security, and modern data architecture principles, including Lakehouse and cloud-native data platforms.
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, modern Lakehouse architectures, and regulated or compliance-driven data environments.

The lead will be responsible for leading a team of help desk professionals, ensuring exceptional customer service, troubleshooting technical issues, and maintaining IT systems that support federal operations.   • Strong leadership abilities to guide teams, resolve conflicts, and make strategic decisions.

Job Description:

We are Omnissa! 

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions—including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance—into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.

Guided by our Core Values—Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value—we’re growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we’d love to hear from you.


At Omnissa, we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.


What is the opportunity?

As a Solutions Consultant in the digital workspace industry, you will play a crucial role in bridging the gap between our technical solutions and our clients' needs. You will be responsible for understanding the intricacies of our product portfolio and effectively communicating their value proposition to your customers. You are: A technical resource who uses your industry, product and solution expertise to educate customers on solutions that are aligned to their business objectives. A partner to your sales counterpart who designs and implements a plan that aligns with the goals of the team - making quota, providing successful outcomes for customers, creating an effective and enjoyable working environment and relationship. A highly valued member of the sales team who is a master resource in the sales kit, one who creates trusted advisor level relationships with customers to round out the sales/SE ‘divide and conquer’ partnership


Here is a breakdown:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with your customers acting as a trusted advisor who is responsible for the end-to-end technical relationship at the customer.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer’s technical environment, business objectives, any business challenges or pain points and align those with the right solution(s).
  • Provide input on opportunities using tight collaboration with your sales counterpart in account planning, campaign development and active engagement in progressing sales stages 3 through 5 – Validate, Prove, Proposal = ownership of technical closure.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge in End User Computing, Digital Transformation, and industry developments including tackling competitive threats and comparisons in sales opportunities.
  • Respond to RFPs/RFIs
  • Presenting our technology vision and value proposition to all levels of audience from executives to technical practitioner at customers and industry events.
  • Pro-actively drive meetings, exhibit strong communication skills and the ability to influence decisions through effective presentations, product demonstrations, and technical discussions with customers at all levels from Executive (CISO) to practitioner.
  • Take full ownership of your accounts by providing thought leadership and perspective while ensuring customer’s best interest takes priority.
  • Deep understanding and product knowledge used in explaining the most up to date product features/benefits and competitive position, understanding and responding to the competition, gathering, and applying market knowledge.
  • Utilize resources and tools to manage whitespace and accuracy of the Install Base to drive expansion in current product lines as well as adoption of additional product lines and/or features.
  • Building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.
  • Orchestrating applicable supporting resources to ensure a one-team approach that properly services the needs of the customer driving to a defined outcome.

Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department. This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.

About the company:

The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.

The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.
  • Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.
  • Order Management: Generate purchase orders for replenishment based on forecasted demand and stock levels, collaborating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Stock Control & Optimization: Monitor and optimize stock levels across the catalog, ensuring products are always available in the required quantities and minimizing overstock.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Provide regular reports on demand forecasts, stock status, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Use advanced analytics to recommend inventory adjustments and supply chain improvements.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with brand managers, supply chain teams, and other stakeholders to align demand forecasts with marketing, promotions, and sales strategies.
  • Amazon Marketplace Management: Oversee inventory management for Amazon, ensuring accurate stock levels, fulfillment coordination, and alignment with marketplace demand trends.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes.
  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Google Spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and demand planning software
  • Experience with Inventory Planner would be a plus
  • This role is essential for maintaining efficient and cost-effective inventory management while supporting the companys growth through data-driven insights and precise demand forecasting.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote and full-time role.
  • Paid time off.
  • Yearly bonuses.
  • Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.
  • Competitive and timely salary.
  • Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.
  • Dynamic, creative work environments.
  • Flexible schedule.

This is a remote position.

Are you an entrepreneurial and experienced solicitor seeking a departure from the traditional law firm model? Our client offers a unique opportunity for skilled legal professionals to join our team of consultant solicitors.
The hiring firm was established with the aim of breaking away from the monotony of traditional law firms. Their innovative business model provides experienced lawyers with the autonomy to control their professional lives, backed by the structure and support of a traditional law firm.

raw.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
raw.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

As Director of Ops & Deputy Managing Director Germany you own the engine that turns interested patients into active customers. You lead our Patient Success team and Customer Support and are accountable for lead conversion, speed from sign-up to start and service quality.

You'll work hand in hand with Growth Marketing on the full D2C funnel and build processes, tooling and a scalable operating model – combining people, automation and AI – from the ground up. You report to the Managing Director Germany.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the conversion funnel from interested patients, to paying customer
  • Hire, lead and coach the Patient Success team; design targets, incentive schemes and quality assurance
  • Own Customer Support for patients, doctors' practices and Krankenkassen: channels, SLAs, CSAT, tooling
  • Redesign the prescription retrieval process (practice communication, status visibility) to cut time-to-activation
  • Lead the AI Ops initiatives and automation
  • Own ops tooling (CRM, telephony, workforce planning) and automation
  • Partner with Growth on lead quality and feed patient insights to Product

What you need to have

  • 5+ years in operations, strategy or consulting, incl. hands-on responsibility for D2C / customer operations – healthcare experience is a plus, not a must
  • Measurable track record of improving funnel conversion rates
  • Experience leading and scaling customer- or patient-facing teams (e.g., patient success, inside sales, customer support), incl. targets and incentive schemes
  • Built processes and teams from scratch in a fast-growing environment
  • Data-driven; comfortable with dashboards (SQL/Looker a plus)
  • Fluent German and English
  • Nice to have: Strategy consulting experience (McKinsey, BCG, Bain), experience with AI/automation in customer operations

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Total Compensation Range
€105.000—€165.000 EUR
Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately.

Job Title:

Clinical Research Coordinator - Comprehensive Cancer Center

Department:

CCC | Sponsored Research

Position Summary

The Clinical Research Coordinator serves as a key member of a multidisciplinary research team supporting federally funded and foundation-funded research projects focused on cancer prevention, cancer control, health disparities, survivorship, and other health-related outcomes in rural and medically underserved communities throughout Ohio. This position is responsible for coordinating and implementing complex clinical and community-based research studies, with a particular emphasis on engaging participants in rural and Appalachian regions.


The Clinical Research Coordinator independently manages day-to-day research operations, facilitates participant recruitment and retention, maintains regulatory compliance, coordinates community partnerships, and ensures timely completion of study milestones. The position requires frequent interaction with study participants, healthcare providers, community organizations, and external collaborators across Ohio. Regular travel throughout rural Ohio is required.


Responsibilities

  • Coordinates multiple clinical, population-based, and community-engaged research studies.
  • Implements study protocols and standard operating procedures in accordance with sponsor, institutional, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversees participant recruitment, enrollment, informed consent, data collection, and follow-up activities.
  • Schedules and conducts study visits in clinical, community, and virtual settings.
  • Maintains study databases and participant tracking systems.
  • Assists investigators with study startup, activation, and closeout activities.
  • Monitors study progress and ensures adherence to project timelines and deliverables.
  • Serves as a primary liaison between research teams and community partners across rural Ohio.
  • Builds and maintains relationships with healthcare organizations, community health centers, faith-based organizations, local health departments, and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinates outreach events, educational programs, health fairs, screening initiatives, and community meetings.
  • Assists with development and implementation of culturally appropriate recruitment and retention strategies.
  • Supports Community Advisory Boards and stakeholder engagement activities.
  • Facilitates participant navigation and addresses barriers to study participation.
  • Prepares and submits Institutional Review Board (IRB) applications, amendments, continuing reviews, and reportable events.
  • Maintains regulatory binders and study documentation.
  • Ensures compliance with federal regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), HIPAA, and university policies.
  • Participates in study monitoring visits, audits, and sponsor reviews.
  • Tracks protocol deviations and assists with corrective action plans when necessary.
  • Collects, enters, verifies, and manages research data using electronic data capture systems.
  • Performs quality assurance and quality control procedures.
  • Generates reports for investigators, sponsors, and project leadership.
  • Assists with preparation of abstracts, manuscripts, presentations, and progress reports.
  • Supports dissemination of research findings to community and academic audiences.
  • Participates in project meetings, training activities, and professional development.
  • Assists with supervision and training of student employees and research assistants.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned to support research program objectives.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree in Biological Sciences, Health Sciences, Social Sciences or other medical field, or equivalent combination of education experience required. 1 year of relevant experience required. 2-4 years of relevant experience preferred.

Additional Information:

Research and Scholarship - Clinical Research - Individual Contributor - Specialized - S2

Location:

Remote Location

Position Type:

Regular

Scheduled Hours:

40

Shift:

Varying Shifts

Growth, Development & Career Paths

Position Summary:

The Director of Compliance is responsible for leading compliance, regulatory reporting, environmental attribute management, and certification functions across the Renewables Division. This senior leadership role ensures the integrity, accuracy, and audit readiness of all renewable fuel production, environmental credit generation, and trading activities while minimizing regulatory and commercial risk.

The Director of Compliance will oversee compliance programs related to Renewable Fuel Standard, Canadian Clean Fuel Regulations (CFR), Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS), 45Z Clean Fuel Production Credits, voluntary carbon markets, and sustainability certifications including ISCC and other future applicable frameworks. The role serves as the primary compliance authority for the organization and partners closely with Commercial, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Government Affairs, and external regulators.

The successful candidate will build and lead a high-performing compliance organization that supports continued growth in RNG, BioLNG, environmental commodities, and emerging decarbonization markets.

Responsibilities

Compliance Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the Renewables Division compliance strategy.
  • Establish governance frameworks, internal controls, compliance policies, and standard operating procedures across all environmental products and renewable fuel operations.
  • Provide strategic guidance to senior leadership on emerging regulatory and market developments.
  • Lead annual compliance planning and risk assessment initiatives.

Environmental Programs & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with EPA Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), California LCFS, Oregon CFP, Canadian Clean Fuel Regulations, 45Z Clean Fuel Production Credit requirements, ISCC and applicable certification programs
  • Ensure compliance with existing and emerging maritime compliance frameworks such as Fuel EU, regional ETS', and IMO
  • Engage with internal and external audiences to drive policy development for new markets and emerging compliance frameworks
  • Oversee registrations, attest engagements, pathway applications, fuel reporting, and environmental attribute reporting activities.
  • Maintain organizational readiness for regulatory reviews and third-party verification activities.

Environmental Attribute Management

  • Ensure accurate generation, transfer, monetization, and retirement of environmental attributes including RINs, LCFS credits, CFR credits, Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs), and voluntary carbon credits.
  • Establish controls over registry activities and environmental asset inventories.
  • Work closely with commercial and trading teams to support structured transactions and environmental commodity marketing activities.

Audit, Governance & Risk Management

  • Lead internal and external compliance audits.
  • Develop comprehensive compliance monitoring programs.
  • Maintain documentation standards sufficient to support regulatory examinations and transaction due diligence.
  • Identify emerging compliance risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate with Legal and Finance on governance and control assessments.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the compliance organization, including managers, analysts, and technical specialists.
  • Establish performance objectives, development plans, and succession strategies.
  • Build organizational capability in regulatory reporting, carbon accounting, lifecycle analysis, and market compliance.
  • Foster a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Regulatory Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as primary company representative with regulators, certification bodies, auditors, and industry organizations.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and communicate impacts to executive leadership.
  • Support Government Relations activities with technical and regulatory expertise.
  • Participate in industry working groups and trade associations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Sustainability, Business, Finance, Public Policy, Law, or related discipline.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or JD preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in renewable fuels, environmental markets, energy compliance, regulatory affairs, or related fields.
  • 5+ years leading compliance, regulatory, or environmental market teams.
  • Deep understanding of EPA RFS, LCFS programs, CFR, 45Z tax credits, carbon accounting methodologies, and ISCC or comparable sustainability certification systems.
  • Experience supporting environmental commodity trading and commercial transactions.
  • Demonstrated success leading regulatory audits and compliance programs in highly regulated industries.

Build a Career with Ownership and Purpose

If you are looking for meaningful work, strong values, and a company that genuinely invests in your future, Roeslein is a place you can grow - professionally and personally.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. The job description does not necessarily contain all the actual or essential duties of this position. All job offers are contingent upon passing a drug screen and criminal background check.

Mid Pay Rate

Company:Driven Brands

Driven Brands is North America's largest automotive services company with a portfolio of iconic brands including Take 5 Oil Change®, Meineke Car Care Centers®, Maaco®, 1-800-Radiator & A/C®, Auto Glass Now®, and CARSTAR®. Our vision is to fuel the pursuit with the simplest, most convenient, and most reliable car care experience.

Every day, we fuel the pursuit — for our customers chasing life's moments, for our franchisees building lasting legacies, and for each other as we grow, lead, and succeed together.
