Because at Driven Brands, we're not just fixing cars. We're building futures, unlocking potential, and fueling what's possible — together.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to protect our people, data, and operations from modern threats, including those enabled by AI (Artificial Intelligence). You will serve as a technical authority on both sides of cybersecurity: defending against active threats, and designing and engineering cybersecurity into every layer of our technology environment. You will partner with IT, Legal, and business leaders to reduce risk across the enterprise.


How you will Own It:


Threat Defense

  • Lead investigation and containment of phishing, account compromise, and endpoint and network threats, correlating signals across endpoint, identity, email, and network data.
  • Monitor and triage alerts, and investigate anomalous identity and email activity, including suspicious sign-ins and business email compromise indicators.
  • Execute rapid response actions, such as disabling accounts, revoking sessions, and blocking indicators, and document root cause and remediation for leadership and auditors.
  • Develop and tune detections and response playbooks based on emerging threats, including AI-enabled attacks, and lessons learned from incidents.
  • Coordinate major incident response across IT, Legal, and external response partners, and strengthen readiness through tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.
  • Perform forensic evidence collection and support legal holds and eDiscovery in partnership with Legal.
  • Share in an on-call rotation providing escalation coverage.

Cybersecurity Engineering

  • Architect and engineer cybersecurity solutions across the full technology stack, including endpoints, networks, identity, email and collaboration, cloud, applications, data, AI systems, and infrastructure, from requirements and design through implementation and lifecycle management.
  • Apply secure-by-design principles such as least privilege, defense in depth, zero trust, and segmentation, using threat modeling and architecture reviews, and maintain cybersecurity standards, reference architectures, and hardened baselines that are monitored for drift.
  • Design and govern identity and access controls with identity and infrastructure teams, including conditional access, network restrictions, privileged-access processes, and non-human identities.
  • Secure cloud and hybrid infrastructure through configuration standards, posture management, and guardrails that scale across environments.
  • Automate and codify cybersecurity controls, deployments, and workflows to reduce manual effort, variance, and risk.
  • Validate and release controls through testing, staged rollouts, and change management, operate cybersecurity platforms for resilience, coverage, and telemetry quality, and evaluate and integrate new technologies through proofs of concept.
  • Drive vulnerability and exposure reduction with infrastructure, cloud, and application owners, prioritizing by business impact and fixing root causes rather than applying one-off patches.

Risk & Governance

  • Assess AI and software vendors for cybersecurity, data protection, and governance risk, and deliver decision-ready recommendations.
  • Provide technical evidence and input for audits, framework maturity reviews, cybersecurity standards, and penetration-test remediation.
  • Manage cybersecurity vendor relationships, including renewals, service retainers, and roadmap input.

What you’ll Bring:

  • 5–8+ years in cybersecurity engineering, cybersecurity operations, or incident response.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Hands-on experience engineering, securing, and administering enterprise technology (endpoints, networks, identity, cloud, email, and applications) and cybersecurity platforms, along with incident response experience.
  • Working knowledge of NIST CSF, CIS, or ISO 27001.
  • One or more certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or Security+.

You’re Good-to-Go if you have:


Sound judgment under pressure, clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, discretion with confidential matters, a collaborative approach to influencing without formal authority, and the curiosity to keep pace with emerging technology and threats.


Added Fuel if you have:


  • Experience securing AI systems, or familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Scripting, automation, and infrastructure-as-code skills (e.g., Python).
  • Cloud security experience across major cloud platforms.
  • Digital forensics and eDiscovery experience.
  • Threat hunting and third-party risk assessment experience.

How Success Is Measured

  • Threat defense: faster detection and response, and incidents closed with documented root cause.
  • Cybersecurity engineering: systems aligned to cybersecurity baselines, strong control coverage, timely remediation of critical vulnerabilities, and automation that reduces manual work and configuration drift.
  • Governance: strong audit outcomes and timely vendor risk decisions.

raw.description:
About Celldex

Celldex is pioneering new horizons in immunology to deliver life-changing therapies. We are relentless in our pursuit of novel antibody-based treatments that engage the human immune system and directly impact critical pathways in allergic, inflammatory, and autoimmune diseases.

We are building a world-class Medical Affairs organization to support late-stage development and launch for the company’s immunology asset. Our culture is entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and deeply mission-driven—where passionate individuals can make a meaningful impact.

Why Join Celldex?

  • Opportunity to build and shape the Field Medical organization at a pivotal stage
  • Direct impact on launch readiness and execution for a late-stage immunology asset
  • Highly visible leadership role with enterprise influence
  • Entrepreneurial culture where leaders can build, innovate, and drive change
  • Mission-driven organization focused on improving the lives of patients with serious diseases

Overview

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) / Senior Medical Science Liaison (Sr. MSL) will prioritize contacts with key opinion leaders (KOLs), healthcare providers, and clinical investigators within an assigned U.S. region, providing scientific exchange and supporting the generation of actionable insights.

This role serves as a field-based extension of the Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation (MA&EG) organization, supporting external engagement and contributing to the understanding of clinical practice, treatment dynamics, and emerging data within immunology and/or dermatology.

The MSL / Sr. MSL is expected to deliver scientifically accurate, relevant, and increasingly insightful discussions, gather and communicate insights from the field, and support execution of regional priorities. With increasing experience, the role operates with greater independence, sound judgment, and scientific depth, contributing more meaningfully to insight interpretation, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional alignment.

Responsibilities

Enhancing knowledge / scientific exchange:

  • Engages in Medical-to-Medical scientific discussions including disease awareness, clinical data, and treatment considerations. Communicates scientific information clearly and effectively to healthcare providers, investigators, and KOLs.
  • Develops and demonstrates increasing depth of knowledge and confidence in scientific exchange, including the ability to navigate more complex or nuanced discussions related to clinical data and treatment paradigms. Builds credibility and trust as a scientific resource within the region and adapts communication appropriately across stakeholder types.

Insight gathering and sharing:

  • Responsible for gathering, synthesizing, and communicating insights from field engagement. Identifies trends in clinical practice, perceptions of data, and factors that influence treatment decisions.
  • With increasing experience, provides more structured, contextualized, and actionable insights, demonstrating the ability to connect individual observations into meaningful themes. Begins to proactively share insights with internal stakeholders and align with MA&EG partners, including HEOR and PRO functions, to support organizational understanding.

Regional ownership / execution:

  • Executes field activities within assigned territory, including planning, prioritization, and engagement. Demonstrates strong organization and time management skills in managing multiple priorities.
  • With increasing experience, operates with greater independence and ownership of the territory, effectively prioritizing high-value engagements and making informed decisions on how to allocate time and resources to maximize impact.

Data interpretation:

  • Applies scientific knowledge to understand and communicate clinical data. Develops the ability to interpret study results and discuss findings appropriately with external stakeholders.
  • With experience, developing confidence in independently interpreting clinical data, including the ability to translate findings into relevant clinical context for different audiences.

Data generation / R&D support:

  • Supports clinical development activities, including engagement with investigators and clinical sites. Participates in site identification, research discussions, and clinical trial awareness, as appropriate.
  • With increasing experience, contributes more actively to investigator engagement and study-related discussions, demonstrating a clearer understanding of clinical trial processes and site dynamics.

Scientific engagement support:

  • Provides scientific support for congresses, advisory boards, and other external engagements. Maintains awareness of scientific literature, emerging research, and competitive landscape.

Cross-functional engagement (field-aligned):

  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders within Medical Affairs to support field engagement and insight exchange.
  • With increasing experience, engages more actively with MA&EG partners, including HEOR and PRO, and demonstrates the ability to align field insights with internal priorities and information needs.

Broader stakeholder engagement (as applicable):

  • Engages healthcare providers and KOLs within assigned region. Develops awareness of broader stakeholders and factors influencing clinical decision-making.
  • With experience, begins to engage a wider range of stakeholders, including larger practices and organizational influencers, with a growing understanding of practice dynamics and access considerations that influence treatment decisions.

Qualifications

  • Strong communication skills and ability to engage in scientific discussions
  • Strong customer-facing, listening, and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to learn and communicate complex scientific information
  • Ability to operate independently with increasing confidence and sound judgment
  • Strong organization, prioritization, and execution capabilities
  • Foundational understanding of clinical trial design and data interpretation
  • Ability to synthesize information and communicate insights effectively
  • Adaptability and ability to operate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Must be able to travel approximately 70%, including some weekends

Education/Experience:

  • MD, NP, PA, PharmD, or PhD in a life science required
  • Specialization in Dermatology, Immunology, or Allergy preferred
  • Prior experience in Medical Affairs, clinical research, or related field preferred
  • Experience level will determine leveling within the role:
  • MSL: 0–3+ years of MSL or related experience; builds foundational capabilities and therapeutic area expertise

Compensation Statement

The expected base salary for this position is: $133579.00 to $213380.00. We are committed to compensating employees equitably based on several factors including experience, education, licensure/certifications, skill level, location of the position, and availability of similar talent in a competitive market. Subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms, compensation includes base salary, annual discretionary bonus, long term incentive, 401(K) plan with employer contribution, health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), paid holidays, vacation, and sick days. A summary of our benefits can be found on our careers page Celldex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that strives to foster a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to promoting a diverse environment through development, recruiting and community outreach.

raw.excerpt: Protect Democracy seeks a thoughtful, detail-oriented fundraiser to join our growing Partnerships team as an Annual Giving Officer.
raw.description:
Protect Democracy seeks a thoughtful, detail-oriented fundraiser to join our growing Partnerships team as an Annual Giving Officer. This is a unique opportunity for a talented early-to-mid-career fundraising professional looking to expand their skill set and make an impact in the movement to protect our democracy. As Annual Giving Officer, you’ll steward a portfolio of mid-level donors and run the engagement tools to grow it, including across our grassroots and peer-to-peer fundraising programs.

About the position: In this role, you’ll be a key player on a small, highly collaborative and effective team. We seek to steward deep, long-term, trusting relationships with donors, engaging them as true partners in the broader democracy ecosystem. That approach has paid off: We’ve raised substantial unrestricted operating funds and built a solid financial runway, which lets us hire exceptional talent and launch high-impact interventions. These include 150+ legal actions, critical federal and state legislation, and creative solutions like VoteShield, which monitors and protects 160 million public voter records across 25 states.

About the organization: Protect Democracy formed in late 2016, recognizing that the global wave of authoritarianism had begun to erode American shores. We have since assembled a team of140+ expertswho have served under Democrats and Republicans and in the senior ranks of other nonprofit, political, or media organizations. Our team includes lawyers, policy experts, legislative advocates, media strategists, writers, data analysts, and software developers. We deploy litigation, legislative and communications strategies, technology, research, and analysis to stand up for free and fair elections, the rule of law, fact-based debate, and a better democracy for future generations. For this work, our team received a Skoll Award for Social Innovation and a MacArthur Fellowship.

This is a remote position based in the United States.* The priority deadline to apply for this role is October 29, 2026; we will review applications received after that date on a rolling basis.

The Annual Giving Officer will:

  • Manage a portfolio that currently has about 300 mid level gift partners—both institutional funders and individuals—leveraging technology to assist in regular communications, soliciting gift renewals, and customized cultivation plans where appropriate;

  • Aim to grow this portfolio of donors to 500 by 2028 through strong collaboration with Partnerships team members, active stewardship, and management of our newly launched peer-to-peer fundraising tool;

  • Write & distribute high-quality quarterly e-newsletter & bi-annual e-appeals to grassroots donors, mostly through synthesis of existing material;

  • Assemble high-quality materials and communications that reflect Protect Democracy’s voice and mission, including grant proposals, reports, and donor correspondence;

  • Represent Protect Democracy in external meetings with donors and trusted intermediaries;

  • Conduct prospect research to identify new high-capacity individuals and institutions aligned with our mission;

  • Collaborate with the Partnerships team to set and track ambitious fundraising goals, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records;

  • Independently seek opportunities to build and improve on Protect Democracy’s fundraising operations by closely examining needs, assessing possible solutions, and making concise recommendations;

  • Contribute to Protect Democracy’s programmatic work and culture.

The ideal candidate brings:

  • Three or more years of professional experience, including experience working directly with donors;

  • Demonstrated comfort and experience with identifying, cultivating, stewarding, closing, and renewing 4-5 figure gift opportunities;

  • Proficiency with fundraising tools and CRMs with a preference for Raiser’s Edge experience, and a desire to help our team use data and automation more effectively;

  • Ability to correspond persuasively and authentically with key stakeholders;

  • A solid understanding of the political and philanthropic landscape;

  • Excellent judgment, time management, and follow-through;

  • A growth mindset and collaborative orientation, including enthusiasm for giving and receiving feedback in all directions;

  • A nuanced understanding of our country’s political landscape, the authoritarian threat, and the reality that our democracy has never fully represented communities of color;

  • Unfettered enthusiasm for Protect Democracy’s cross-ideological and nonpartisan approach to protecting our democracy.

At Protect Democracy, we believe that diversity isn’t just a strength — it’s a necessity for tackling the complex challenges facing democracy. A broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthens our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. We strongly encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds and from across the political and ideological spectrum to apply. If you meet most but not all of the criteria listed above but believe nonetheless you’d be a stellar match for the role and could grow into it, we want to hear from you. The Partnerships team thrives on having a variety of perspectives and expertise working highly collaboratively.

Compensation

The starting salary range for this role is $84,300-$94,000 (FLSA Exempt), commensurate with the candidate’s relevant experience, capabilities, and skills, and in alignment with internal equity.

About Protect Democracy

  • *Flexible location. We are a remote-first organization based exclusively in the United States, meaning our staff work within the US and primarily virtually. We also offer shared workspaces for those who enjoy working in an office environment. We are established for remote work in many states across the country, and while candidates based anywhere in the United States are welcome to apply, we may not be able to offer employment in your current location. If you proceed in the hiring process, we will discuss where you currently live and what is possible in our initial interview. All staff are also required to travel at least two times per year to team retreats, and this role also requires periodic travel. (Accommodations to this requirement will be made only in exceptional circumstances.)

  • Commitment to an inclusive workplace. Protect Democracy is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthens our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. Protect Democracy encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

  • Phenomenal benefits. Our benefits package includes generous sick leave and a flexible vacation policy where we encourage team members to take 4-5 weeks every year, along with 12 paid holidays, 6 weeks of paid family medical leave, and 18 weeks of paid parental leave. We also offer a 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer match that vests immediately. Additionally, we cover employee medical premiums at 100% (with up to 95% coverage for dependents depending on plan selection), and employee and dependents dental/vision at 100%. All employees have access to long-term disability and life insurance, fertility benefits, a home office stipend, and bonuses at the discretion of the Executive Director.

  • Ample opportunities for personal & professional development. Candidates who do not meet all listed criteria should still apply, as our organizational structure focuses on providing mentorship and opportunities for professional growth.

To apply for this position, please complete the application linked below. As part of your application, you will be asked to answer a couple screener questions and upload a PDF of your resume. We are weighing responses to our short answer questions highly, so cover letters are truly optional for this role. Not including a cover letter will not be counted against you. That said, we have left the option in case there is something compelling you want to share that you don't believe will come across in your resume alone.

The priority deadline to apply for this role is October 29, 2026; we will review applications received after that date on a rolling basis.

Applications missing any of the required materials will be considered incomplete and not reviewed.

Important notes

  • Contact if you require specific accommodations at any point in the hiring process.

  • Keep an eye on your promotions/spam folders to avoid missed communication.

  • A note on fair hiring and automated tech: To help our small team review applications efficiently and fairly, we use automated screening tools to assist with resume and response review. Every candidate flagged by our system is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team; we never rely on automated scoring alone to make hiring decisions. If you have questions about this process, or need an alternative application path as an accommodation, reach out to us at .

  • We are unable to provide status updates for each application we receive. If you reach out and do not hear back, please know it is not for lack of appreciation or interest, but simply for lack of staff capacity to respond to individual inquiries.

  • The application will include a voluntary EEO survey so that we can monitor the applicant pool as a whole for representation and equal employment opportunities, and to evaluate our progress as an organization toward a diverse and inclusive workforce, which we believe is a pillar of a thriving democracy. The categories used by the EEO survey are limited and may not reflect your lived experience; please feel free to opt out of any of the questions. Your responses to this survey are entirely separate from your application materials, are not accessible to those responsible for hiring decisions, and will not affect your candidacy in any way.

Highlights

Join our small, high impact, remote team to build lasting donor relationships that protect democracy. Manage a 300-donor partner portfolio and help grow our grassroots and peer-to-peer programs.

raw.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

​The Manager, Customer Success leads the ANZ Success team and is accountable for helping customers realise measurable value from Granicus products and services. The role combines people leadership, portfolio oversight and disciplined execution to strengthen adoption, retention, customer advocacy and sustainable growth across our public sector customer base.

​This leader creates clarity and consistency across the customer lifecycle, coaches Customer Success team members to operate as trusted advisers, and partners closely with Sales, Implementation, Support, Product and Marketing. The role uses customer data, commercial insight and practical knowledge of the ANZ public sector to identify risk early, improve customer outcomes and help the existing customer base become a source of sustained retention, advocacy and growth.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

Essential Functions

  • ​​Lead, coach and develop the ANZ Success team, setting clear expectations for customer outcomes, portfolio discipline, quality, productivity and professional growth.
  • ​Create an inclusive, accountable team environment that encourages open communication, sound judgement, continuous learning and high ethical standards.
  • ​Own team performance across product adoption, customer engagement, value realisation, retention, risk management, well qualified growth opportunities and completion of agreed customer engagements.
  • ​Guide the team in using clear customer plans, structured reviews and agreed engagement rhythms that connect customer priorities to measurable outcomes.
  • ​Apply agreed guiding principles for customer segmentation and engagement so the level of service is aligned to customer value, complexity, risk and opportunity.
  • ​Lead the coordinated response for customers at risk, ensuring clear ownership, timely recovery plans, appropriate leadership visibility and effective cross functional action.
  • ​Manage escalations with professionalism and urgency, balancing customer advocacy, commercial context and sustainable outcomes for Granicus.
  • ​Maintain accurate portfolio, churn and renewal forecasts, and provide clear reporting on customer health, engagement, risk, retention and growth opportunities.
  • ​Build a strong working partnership between Customer Success and Sales, with shared customer context, coordinated engagement and early identification of qualified growth opportunities recorded in Salesforce.
  • ​Partner with Implementation Services, Support, Product and Marketing to improve onboarding transitions, adoption, issue resolution, customer communications and advocacy.
  • ​Use customer insights, usage data and feedback to identify trends, improve playbooks and inform product direction, service design and regional priorities.
  • ​Champion consistent use of systems, processes and documentation, balancing global standards with ANZ customer needs and public sector practices.
  • ​Represent Granicus in customer, partner and industry forums, strengthening trusted relationships and the company's reputation across the region.
  • ​Use approved AI enabled tools and automation to improve analysis, preparation, customer prioritisation, consistent service delivery and customer communication. Model responsible use by validating outputs, protecting customer and company information, and following Granicus privacy, security and acceptable use requirements.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • ​Proven people leadership, coaching and performance management capability, with the ability to set direction while enabling individual ownership.
  • ​Strong commercial judgement and understanding of the relationship between customer outcomes, adoption, retention, renewal confidence and growth.
  • ​Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including confidence with senior customer and internal leaders.
  • ​Ability to interpret customer data, health signals and portfolio trends, turning insight into clear priorities and action.
  • ​Strong problem solving and escalation management skills, with calm judgement in complex or ambiguous situations.
  • ​Working knowledge of SaaS Customer Success practices, customer lifecycle management and scalable engagement models.
  • ​Ability to collaborate across functions and influence outcomes without relying on direct authority.
  • ​High standards of organisation, follow through, written communication, presentation and data quality.
  • ​Commitment to customer value, public sector impact, diversity of thought and continuous improvement.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Experience/Credentials:

  • ​​Five or more years of increasing responsibility in Customer Success, account management, consulting, SaaS or a comparable customer facing discipline.
  • ​Demonstrated experience leading, coaching or developing customer facing professionals, through formal people management or substantial team leadership responsibility.
  • ​Experience owning customer retention, adoption, risk, value or growth outcomes across a portfolio.
  • ​Experience working with public sector, local government, community engagement, digital experience or civic technology customers is highly regarded.
  • ​Experience using Salesforce and Customer Success, analytics or business intelligence tools to manage priorities and report performance.
  • ​Tertiary qualifications or equivalent practical experience in business, technology, government, communications or a related field.​

Other Job Info

  • This role is performed primarily in a remote office environment using collaboration, customer management and analytics tools.
  • Flexibility may be required to support customers and colleagues across Australia, New Zealand and global time zones.
  • Travel may be required for customer meetings, team sessions and Granicus commitments.

Security Requirement:

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.
  • A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
  • Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
  • We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

raw.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword is looking for an Advisor, Health Plans to own several of our most strategically important health-plan relationships. This is a senior individual-contributor role with direct accountability for revenue retention, member marketing access, relationship strength, and the account conditions that enable cross-sell and upsell.

You will act as the general manager of a concentrated payer portfolio. The work spans claims and ROI economics, marketing approvals, member access, product expansion, executive relationships, and complex operating dependencies across Sword, the plan, its subsidiaries, employer groups, and other stakeholders. Success requires the judgment to identify the real constraint, the analytical depth to understand the economics and evidence personally, and the authority to mobilize teams you do not manage.

Sales will own commercial negotiations. You will make those negotiations more likely to succeed by building the relationships, gathering the intelligence, shaping the business case, and resolving the operating and value questions that determine retention and growth.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the success of a concentrated portfolio of strategic health-plan relationships, protecting revenue retention and creating the conditions for growth.

  • Secure and expand the approvals, channels, data, and subsidiary participation that put Sword in front of eligible members, then determine whether that access is producing enrollment, utilization, and value.

  • Build a multi-threaded network across economic, clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders, including the people who can quietly block access, renewal, or expansion.

  • Interrogate claims, utilization, outcomes, guarantees, attribution, and ROI evidence, then lead account strategy, value communication, business reviews, and escalations.

  • Partner with Sales on cross-sell and upsell and mobilize Sword's internal specialists as resources in an account plan you still own.

  • Operate with significant autonomy, identifying emerging risks and opportunities, defining strategy where playbooks do not exist, and driving execution across the organization.

What you need to have

  • Substantial experience managing health plans as customers from a digital-health, healthcare-technology, benefits, navigation, PBM, payer-services, or similarly relevant vendor.

  • A track record of retaining and growing consequential payer relationships, including securing marketing access or comparable downstream action.

  • Working depth in claims and ROI economics, with the ability to interrogate methodology, reconcile conflicting evidence, and stand behind the account position.

  • Strong executive judgment and exceptional written and verbal communication across functions, levels, and competing stakeholder interests.

  • Hands-on analytical self-sufficiency and a low-ego, high-ownership operating style, plus willingness to travel domestically up to 10%.

  • The ability to thrive in highly ambiguous environments where priorities evolve quickly and success depends on judgment rather than process.

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Total Compensation Range
$147,700—$232,100 USD
Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately.
Sword Health complies with applicable Federal and State civil rights laws and does not discriminate on the basis of Age, Ancestry, Color, Citizenship, Gender, Gender expression, Gender identity, Gender information, Marital status, Medical condition, National origin, Physical or mental disability, Pregnancy, Race, Religion, Caste, Sexual orientation, and Veteran status.

You will play a key role in delivering high-quality regulatory documents, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the growth of the wider team. The Medical Writer will be responsible for medical writing including:

Key Responsibilities:

  • Author, review, and quality check a range of regulatory and pharmacovigilance documents, including:
    • PSURs/PBRERs
    • PADERs
    • ACOs
    • DSURs
    • Risk Management Plans (RMPs)
  • Ensure documents are scientifically accurate, regulatory compliant, and delivered within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyse, interpret, and present safety data effectively.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients, supporting project delivery and fostering strong working relationships.
  • Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to junior medical writers to support their professional growth and development.
  • Contribute to process improvements and the continuous enhancement of medical writing quality standards.

  • Minimum 2 years' experience in Medical Writing and associated fields (case processing, signal detection or risk management) ideally within a CRO environment
  • Ability to manage multiple and varied tasks and prioritize workload with attention to detail
  • Ability to effectively train and mentor Associate Medical Writers
  • Must be a strong team player
  • Fluency in English, an additional language is a benefit

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

This is a remote position.

Our client, a leading regional firm, are seeking a Solicitor to join their busy Personal Injury & Clinical Negligence department. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic and growing team that handles a wide range of personal injury and clinical negligence claims. Our client welcomes applicants with varying levels of experience, including those from outside the local area, as remote work with occasional office visits will be considered.

Role Overview:

The successful candidate will manage a caseload of diverse claims, assisting clients who have been affected by road traffic accidents, employer’s liability, public liability incidents, medical negligence, and more. You will have the opportunity to handle cases from initial client contact through to settlement, working closely with clients to deliver the highest level of service.

This is a full-time position, though part-time hours may be considered for the right candidate. You will report directly to the Director & Head of Personal Injury & Clinical Negligence.

  • Funding and Advice: Advise clients on potential funding options, including conditional fee agreements (CFA) or other funding arrangements, ensuring the client understands their financial obligations throughout the case.

  • Liaison and Communication: Collaborate with external stakeholders such as opponents, insurers, ATE providers, and experts. Draft letters of advice, witness statements, and other key documentation.

  • Costs Management: At the conclusion of a claim, assist in the assessment of costs, including any success fees and working with a costs draftsman where necessary to ensure the financial aspects of the case are handled properly.

  • Team Contribution: Work closely with the team, sharing knowledge and providing assistance where needed. Support business development efforts to promote the firm's reputation and secure new clients.

Working Hours:
9:00 AM – 5:15 PM, Monday to Friday (flexibility available upon discussion during the interview process).
Salary:
Competitive salary, dependent on experience, to be discussed during the interview.

Requirements

  • Legal Expertise: Prior experience in Personal Injury or Clinical Negligence is preferred, but candidates with other relevant experience will also be considered.

  • Client-Focused Approach: Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive client situations with empathy, professionalism, and clear communication.
  • Commercial Awareness: A practical understanding of the commercial considerations of cases, including the ability to assess risks, outcomes, and funding options.
  • Team Player: Willingness to collaborate with colleagues, contribute to team goals, and participate in business development initiatives to grow the firm's client base.
  • Professional Development: Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to stay up-to-date with developments in personal injury and clinical negligence law.

  • Competitive salary and benefits
  • High quality work
  • Great opportunity for progression​

Fabula is a fast-growing D2C coffee brand in the United States. We're looking for a Head of Growth aka killer performance media buyer/creative strategist who is already operating at a high level in eCommerce. This isn't a role for someone who wants to learn how to scale an eCommerce brand. We want someone who has already done it.

Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Fabula to the next level.

What you'll own

  • Paid media: Own and scale Meta as the primary acquisition channel, with additional experience across Google and/or TikTok Paid
  • Creative strategy: Identify winning customer angles, hooks, messaging, formats, and concepts based on performance data and customer research
  • Creative testing: Build and manage a systematic testing pipeline and rapidly identify winning creatives
  • Full-funnel performance: Analyze and optimize the entire journey from ad advertorial/landing page offer conversion
  • Research: Mine customer reviews, surveys, Reddit, competitor ads, Meta Ads Library, and other sources for new angles and opportunities
  • Creative production: Brief and manage UGC creators, editors, and designers - while remaining hands-on with scripts, hooks, copy, and creative direction
  • Performance analysis: Make daily decisions around what to scale, iterate, or kill based on CPA, ROAS, CTR, hook rate, thumbstop rate, CVR, contribution margin, and other relevant metrics
  • Scaling: Take proven creative and media-buying strategies and turn them into significant increases in profitable spend
  • Funnels: Work on advertorials, landing pages, VSLs, offers, and other conversion assets to improve overall acquisition efficiency
  • AI: Use AI aggressively to accelerate research, creative ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflows

What success looks like

We don't measure activity; we measure results. This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.

Success means:

  • Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics
  • Improving ROAS and reducing CPA
  • Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity
  • Finding new winning angles and audiences
  • Improving conversion rates across the funnel
  • Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system
  • Ultimately, taking Fabula to the next level

You are

  • 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)
  • A proven Meta media buyer who has personally scaled campaigns, not just overseen them (at least $50k/month in ad spend)
  • Equally strong on creative strategy and performance marketing
  • Deeply experienced with direct-response advertising and customer psychology
  • Able to look at an ad account, creative performance, and funnel data and immediately identify what needs to change
  • Experienced scaling DTC/eCommerce brands - not B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or general marketing
  • Hands-on with creative: you can write or heavily edit hooks, scripts, headlines, briefs, and landing page copy
  • Experienced managing creative production with UGC creators, editors, and designers
  • An operator, not a consultant. You don't just make recommendations - you execute, test, learn, and scale
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and taking significant ownership with minimal hand-holding
  • AI-native: you use AI daily to accelerate research, creative development, analysis, and execution
  • Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

Strong bonus points

  • Experience scaling supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands
  • Experience with advertorials, VSLs, or aggressive direct-response funnels
  • Experience with TikTok Paid / Spark Ads
  • Experience with Outbrain or Taboola
  • Experience with tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Motion, Foreplay, or similar
  • Strong understanding of FTC/FDA considerations for supplement advertising

Important: Who this role is NOT for

This is not a fit if:

  • You've managed less than $200K/month in ad spend
  • Your background is primarily organic social or influencer marketing
  • You're primarily a creative strategist who doesn't understand media buying
  • You're primarily a media buyer who relies on someone else for all creative strategy
  • You've worked mainly in B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or non-eCommerce environments
  • You're looking for a role where someone else tells you what to do

We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.

Schedule

  • Fully remote
  • Full-time
  • Minimum 6-hour overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET)
  • Direct collaboration with the founders
  • Significant ownership and autonomy
  • Possible equity upside for strong performance

TigerConnect transforms healthcare with the industry’s most widely adopted clinical collaboration platform – uniquely modernizing the way doctors, nurses, care teams, patients, and data connect. With solutions spanning care team communication, scheduling automation, alarm management and event notifications, nurse call, patient engagement and more, we accelerate productivity, reduce costs, and improve patient outcomes, safely and securely. More than 8,000 healthcare organizations trust us to deliver enterprise-ready solutions, making this possible with the right group of dedicated, thoughtful trailblazers. Today, private practice doctor’s offices, small and large hospice centers, and some of the largest healthcare organizations in the United States rely on TigerConnect. We’re a fun, hungry, smart, innovative group of eclectic people who are passionate about transforming the way clinical care teams work and communicate.


Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated SeniorImplementation Project Manager to lead the implementation of our TigerConnect solutions for clinical workflow optimization.  The Senior Implementation Project Manager is integral to the Customer organization’s PMO team providing exceptional administrator and implementation expertise.

Working in a complex and dynamic environment, this experienced professional will be responsible for TigerConnect software implementation, training, maintenance, and system enhancements to deliver the platform to our customers successfully. You will also be responsible for the successful execution of the project from initiation to closure, including guiding the customer’s change management, ensuring that the project is delivered on time and within scope and budget. You will also manage stakeholders, identify and mitigate project risks, and ensure that customer value and ROI are achieved.

The Senior Project Manager possesses business acumen and sophisticated analytic thinking, advanced knowledge of TigerConnect’s capabilities/integrations, and a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with team members at all levels, including executive leadership. You will be a champion of Project Managment process and seek opportunities to improve the PMO and interdepartmental collaboration for enhanced project and product output.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

  • Implement the TigerConnect solutions and products by leading the initial software build; this will include:
  • Identify and mitigate project risks and develop contingency plans as needed
  • Establish and maintain effective communication channels with project stakeholders, including status reporting and escalation of issues
  • Provide leadership and direction to project team members, including managing resources, providing guidance and feedback, and promoting teamwork and collaboration
  • Conduct lessons learned at Project Closure and identify opportunities for process improvement inside and outside the PMO

About the Role

Realty.com is hiring an Inbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) to support our growing inbound demand. This is a high-volume, structured role focused on qualifying inbound leads, having productive conversations, and setting high-quality demos for our sales team.

This role is not closing-focused and not full-cycle sales. Success is measured by consistency, follow-through, and execution.

If you enjoy talking to people, can stay disciplined in a repeatable daily workflow, and want to build a long-term career in sales, this role offers strong training, clear expectations, and a defined growth path.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond quickly to inbound leads via phone, text, and email

  • Have structured qualification conversations using the provided scripts

  • Identify customer intent and route leads appropriately

  • Set qualified demos for Account Executives

  • Track all activity accurately in our CRM

  • Follow daily call, activity, and quality standards

  • Stay focused, organized, and consistent throughout the day

This role involves a high volume of outbound calls to inbound leads. You will be on the phone daily.

What This Role Is (and Is Not)

This role is:

  • Inbound-only (no cold prospecting)

  • Process-driven and highly structured

  • Entry-level and training-focused

  • A stepping stone to more advanced sales roles

This role is not:

  • A closing or Account Executive position

  • Commission-only or high-ticket sales

  • A “build your own book” role

  • A fit for senior or full-cycle sales reps

Who We’re Looking For

  • Early-career candidates or recent graduates

  • Strong communicators who can stay calm and professional on the phone

  • People who are comfortable with repetition and routine

  • Coachable, reliable, and detail-oriented individuals

  • Prior sales experience is not required — training is provided

Compensation & Growth

  • Base salary with performance-based bonuses

  • Clear expectations and measurable success metrics

  • Opportunity to grow into advanced sales roles over time

Why Realty.com

Realty.com is a fast-growing real estate technology company focused on building scalable, data-driven sales systems. We value structure, clarity, and accountability, and we invest in people who want to grow within those systems.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Strong verbal communication skills and comfort speaking on the phone daily

  • Ability to follow scripts, processes, and daily activity expectations

  • High level of organization and attention to detail

  • Consistent work ethic and reliability

  • Coachable mindset and openness to feedback

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment

  • Basic computer literacy and ability to learn CRM tools

Nice to Have (Not Required)

  • Prior experience in sales, customer service, or call-center environments

  • Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)

  • Interest in pursuing a long-term career in sales

This Role Is a Strong Fit If You

  • Enjoy structured, repeatable work and clear expectations

  • Can handle rejection and stay focused throughout the day

  • Prefer being measured by effort and execution rather than guesswork

  • Want to build foundational sales skills before moving into a closing role

This Role Is Not a Fit If You

  • Are looking for a senior, closing, or full-cycle sales role

  • Dislike being on the phone for a large portion of the day

  • Need constant variety or unstructured work

  • Are primarily motivated by uncapped commissions or high-ticket deals

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • College coursework or degree is a plus but not required

Highlights

Inbound-only sales role focused on qualifying leads and setting demos. Entry-level, structured, phone-based position with clear training, performance metrics, and a defined path to grow in sales.

Position Summary

A second-level support role involves diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues that have been escalated from the first level of support. This role requires advanced knowledge of hardware, software, and networks. Key responsibilities include advanced troubleshooting, managing escalated tickets, providing technical guidance to junior staff, and documenting solutions.

The Helpdesk Technician – Tier II plays a crucial role within the Help Desk, acting as a critical escalation point. This role is instrumental in driving operational excellence by ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and providing a high-touch customer experience. Additionally, the Helpdesk Technician – Tier II collaborates seamlessly with the Infrastructure team to optimize the end-user technology ecosystem and maintain business continuity across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot complex issues by diagnosing, resolving or providing root-cause analysis of incidents across complex hardware, software, and network platforms.
  • Receive, prioritize, and manage support ticket workflows in the ITSM systems, ensuring alignment with SLA/OLA thresholds and proactive communication with departments regarding service impacts.
  • Document solutions by creating and maintaining detailed documentation of all technical issues, steps taken, and resolutions to build a knowledge base to reduce repeat incident volume.
  • Participate in problem management initiatives, identifying systemic issues and recommending strategic solutions to reduce incident recurrence.
  • Partner with Tier 1 Technicians to mentor, reinforce knowledge transfer around emerging technologies and best practices while improving the overall team's efficiency.
  • Identify and escalate critical or unresolved issues to Level 3 support, providing detailed handover information.
  • Support on-site and remote workforce environments, ensuring seamless user experience across hybrid, multi-site, and distributed operating models.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of Help Desk support experience, with at least 1–2 years in a Tier II capacity within an enterprise environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Windows Server/Client OS (e.g., Windows, Linux, macOS), Active Directory, Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID, software applications (e.g., M365/Microsoft Office), cloud service platform (e.g., Azure Virtual Desktop/ AVD), network fundamentals (e.g., DHCP, DNS, VPN) and standard enterprise management tools (ServiceNow, NinjaOne).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify root causes of complex issues while using remote access tools.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
  • Focused mindset on delivering value-added engagement with end users at all touchpoints.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently with minimal supervision, and pivot rapidly in a dynamic support landscape while maintaining quality of service.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree from an accredited institution with 3+ years of Help Desk experience OR
  • High school diploma or GED equivalent, with 5+ years of Help Desk experience can be substituted for a degree
  • IT Certifications: CompTIA Certification A+, Network+, or Security+
  • Exposure to virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix) and cloud service ecosystems (Azure, AWS, GCP).

About Exoticca

Exoticca is a pioneering online travel agency that has revolutionized the conception, production, and e-commerce of long-distance dream trips. At the core of Exoticca's brand equity is the commitment to "creating life milestones." We believe in delivering best-value trips, exploring unique destinations, curating extraordinary travel experiences, and demonstrating genuine care for both our customers and the planet.

We are a professional, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

What are we proposing?

As a FullStack Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and building modern, scalable services using NextJS, Nodejs, TypeScript, and MongoDB.

You’ll develop robust, maintainable services that power our platform, ensuring performance, reliability, and seamless integration across systems.

Your technical insight and creativity will help shape a modular, event-driven architecture (EDA) that enables efficient communication between services and supports our continuous growth and evolution of our e-commerce website.

Responsibilities

    • Design and develop scalable services, contributing to the evolution of a modern, event-driven architecture.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions that are reliable, efficient, and easy to extend.
    • Implement and maintain clean service interfaces and data flows following EDA principles, ensuring smooth communication between components and systems.
    • Write high-quality, testable code supported by automated testing and continuous integration pipelines.
    • Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical design sessions to uphold engineering standards and promote knowledge sharing.
    • Continuously improve system design and development practices to support scalability and future growth of the platform.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining backend applications in Node.js production environments.
    • Experience developing modern web interfaces using React + TypeScript and NextJS (both SPA and SSR/SSG modes) for production environments.
    • Hands-on experience with MongoDB, including data modeling and performance optimization for document-based systems.
    • Solid knowledge of RESTful API design, development, and integration best practices.
    • Experience working with event-driven architectures (EDA) and message-based communication between services.
    • Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and clean architecture principles.
    • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control best practices using Git (GitHub Actions or similar).
    • Strong emphasis on testing (unit, integration) and commitment to code quality, scalability, and maintainability.
    • Familiarity with observability practices — including logging, monitoring, and tracing — to ensure visibility and reliability across distributed services.
    • Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package, in line with job responsibilities and experience.
  • Flexible compensation on transportation and food with Cobee also in our private health insurance.
  • Flexible working schedule, just make sure you meet your monthly goals!
  • 100% Remote working within Spain.
  • Permanent contract from the start.
  • Travel with Exoticca at reduced prices !!!
  • Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you can earn a very nice bonus!
  • And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization where teamwork, drive, commitment, resilience and being customer-centric are the core values.

Exoticca is an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and inclusiveness are our core. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under European, country, or local law.

If you are enthusiastic about education, using your skills and talents to help improve people’s lives, and interested in working on a team of professionals at a globally respected education organization- you’ve found the right place. We are the intersection of education and technology, providing our students and clients with an experience that not only allows them to achieve their goals but also ignites lifelong learning. Remote/Nationwide, USA

Employee

Blueprint was founded by Bryan Johnson, who is competing for the world’s best comprehensive biomarkers. He is the world’s most measured human.

We’re a small, tight-knit team working to clean up the global food supply, provide healthy food to everyone, and build Don’t Die into the most influential ideology in the world. We move quickly, work efficiently, and enjoy an environment defined by competence.

We’re seeking a Senior Director of Product Marketing to lead how Blueprint communicates what we build — and why it matters.

Blueprint is scaling quickly across supplements, nutrition, and health tech, and we’re building toward major new categories. This role will sit at the intersection of Product, Growth, Content, Creative, and Science to define our product narratives, messaging frameworks, and go-to-market strategy.

You will own product marketing end-to-end: positioning, launches, messaging, customer insight, and product storytelling across the entire portfolio. This is a high-leverage leadership role with the opportunity to define the next era of human.

  • Own Blueprint’s product positioning and messaging across all product lines
  • Lead go-to-market strategy for new product launches and major product iterations
  • Build messaging frameworks that translate scientific rigor into clear, compelling consumer narratives
  • Partner closely with Growth and E-Commerce to improve conversion, retention, and LTV through sharper product communication
  • Collaborate with Science and Legal teams to ensure accuracy and compliance across all product marketing claims
  • Develop and maintain a product marketing playbook: launch process, GTM channel best practices, testing, learnings, and iteration
  • Drive customer research, segmentation, and competitive analysis to inform positioning and R&D roadmap decisions.
  • Manage and grow a product marketing team over time (hire, develop, set standards)

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Creative, Growth, and leadership teams
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to tie messaging decisions to performance outcomes
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment with high standards and minimal bureaucracy

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in a regulated industry (supplements, wellness, diagnostics, medical devices, pharma, biotech)

  • Experience in DTC subscription or ecommerce businesses
  • Strong familiarity with scientific/clinical data and the ability to translate it into consumer-facing language
  • Experience building or scaling product marketing teams and launch processes

Salary Range: $220-290k + equity + benefits

raw.description:
Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом. Більше 30 років ми створюємо та вибудовуємо банківську систему нашої держави.

У Райфі працює понад 5 тисяч співробітників, серед них одна із найбільших продуктових ІТ-команд, що налічує 900+ фахівців. Щодня пліч-о-пліч ми працюємо, щоб більш ніж 2,5 мільйона наших клієнтів могли отримати якісне обслуговування, користуватися продуктами і сервісами банку, розвивати бізнес, адже ми #Разом_з_Україною. 


Твої майбутні обов’язки: 

  • Здійснювати продаж банківських продуктів існуючим та новим клієнтам банку

Твій досвід та навички: 

  • Вільно володієш українською мовою
  • Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером
  • Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла
  • Готовий до роботи у напрямку телефонних продажів
  • Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації
  • Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми
  • Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді
  • Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

  • Конкурентна заробітна плата: гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.
  • Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.
  • Комфортні умови праці: гібридний формат роботи у м. Івано-Франківськ або віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
    (засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)
  • Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.
  • Навчання та розвиток: повний супровід на старті (онбординг); тренерський центр для розвитку навичок; доступ до понад 130 навчальних онлайн-ресурсів; програма менторства; онлайн-бібліотека.
  • Крута команда: наші колеги – це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.
  • Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.
  • Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк?  Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення! 

    • Один із найбільших кредиторів економіки та аграрного бізнесу серед приватних банків 
    • Визнаний найкращим працедавцем за версіями EY, Forbes, Robota.ua, Stud-Point, Delo.UA, NV, Odgers, UAFIC
    • Найбільший донор гуманітарної допомоги серед банків (Червоний Хрест України, UNITED24, Superhumans, СМІЛИВІ) 
    • Одна з найбільших ІТ-продуктових команд серед банків країни 
    • Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

    • Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів

Business Development Representative (BDR) – B2B SaaS, Outbound Sales & Lead Generation

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Colombia, Mexico, Brazil
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Business Development Representative (BDR) to generate qualified opportunities and build a consistent B2B sales pipeline.

This is a quota-carrying, execution-focused sales role for someone who is comfortable prospecting every day, speaking with decision-makers, qualifying inbound opportunities, and turning cold outreach into booked meetings.

You’ll own both inbound lead qualification and outbound prospecting, using modern sales tools and multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn.

Your primary objective is simple: create qualified pipeline that turns into revenue.

If you have experience as an SDR or BDR, are confident cold calling U.S.-based prospects, and enjoy working toward measurable targets, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns using:

  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Apollo
  • ZoomInfo
  • Email
  • Cold calling
  • LinkedIn outreach

You’ll:

  • Research target accounts and decision-makers.
  • Build high-quality prospect lists.
  • Execute personalized multi-channel outreach sequences.
  • Cold call prospective customers.
  • Write compelling cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • Test messaging, sequences, and outreach strategies.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects.
  • Generate qualified meetings for Account Executives.

Inbound Lead Qualification

Respond quickly to inbound leads generated through:

  • Marketing campaigns
  • Website inquiries
  • Events
  • Other demand-generation channels

Conduct discovery and qualification conversations to understand:

  • Business needs
  • Pain points
  • Budget
  • Decision-making authority
  • Buying process
  • Timeline

Determine whether opportunities meet qualification criteria and move qualified prospects into the sales pipeline.

Discovery Calls & Meeting Booking

Conduct professional conversations with B2B prospects and decision-makers.

You’ll:

  • Ask effective discovery questions.
  • Identify business challenges and buying intent.
  • Understand prospect needs before positioning next steps.
  • Handle common objections confidently.
  • Qualify opportunities accurately.
  • Schedule qualified meetings and demos for Account Executives.
  • Provide clear handoff notes so AEs enter meetings with the right context.

CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate sales records using platforms such as:

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • Zoho CRM

Track:

  • Prospect activity
  • Calls
  • Emails
  • Qualification notes
  • Follow-ups
  • Opportunity stages
  • Meetings booked

Maintain strong CRM hygiene so the sales team has reliable visibility into pipeline activity and next steps.

Lead Nurturing & Follow-Up

Not every prospect will be ready to buy immediately.

You’ll:

  • Nurture early-stage opportunities.
  • Maintain structured follow-up cadences.
  • Re-engage prospects at the right time.
  • Track next steps and buying signals.
  • Ensure qualified prospects don’t disappear because of missed follow-ups.

Sales Collaboration & Optimization

Work closely with Account Executives and sales leadership on:

  • Pipeline reviews
  • Target account strategy
  • Qualification criteria
  • Prospect feedback
  • Objection patterns
  • Outreach messaging

Share insights from prospect conversations to help improve targeting and sales execution.

Continuously evaluate:

  • Reply rates
  • Connect rates
  • Meetings booked
  • Qualification rates
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion
  • Pipeline generated

Use performance data to improve your outreach approach.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of experience as a BDR, SDR, Inside Sales Representative, or similar B2B sales professional.
  • Proven track record of:
    • Meeting or exceeding quota
    • Booking qualified meetings
    • Generating sales pipeline
  • Hands-on outbound prospecting experience.
  • Confidence with:
    • Cold calling
    • Cold email
    • LinkedIn prospecting
  • Experience with prospecting tools such as:
    • Apollo
    • ZoomInfo
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Zoho CRM
  • Strong discovery and lead qualification skills.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based prospects and decision-makers.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through.
  • Metrics-driven and comfortable working toward activity and pipeline targets.
  • Resilient and comfortable handling rejection.
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours.
  • Based in Colombia, Mexico, or Brazil.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • B2B SaaS sales experience.
  • Technology or professional services sales experience.
  • Experience running structured outbound campaigns.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as:
    • SPIN
    • MEDDIC
    • Challenger
  • Experience working with Account Executives in a structured SDR/BDR organization.
  • Experience selling into U.S. businesses.
  • Experience prospecting senior decision-makers.
  • Familiarity with sales engagement and sequencing tools.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are comfortable picking up the phone and starting conversations.
  • Know how to personalize outreach without sacrificing volume.
  • Understand the difference between booking meetings and booking qualified meetings.
  • Ask thoughtful discovery questions rather than immediately pitching.
  • Follow up consistently without needing reminders.
  • Stay motivated despite rejection.
  • Think in terms of pipeline and revenue, not activity alone.
  • Keep your CRM clean and accurate.
  • Take ownership of your numbers.
  • Constantly test ways to improve your conversion rates.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing new inbound leads and responding quickly.
  • Researching target accounts and decision-makers.
  • Building prospect lists using Apollo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Making outbound cold calls.
  • Sending personalized cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • Running discovery and qualification calls.
  • Following up with warm and previously contacted prospects.
  • Booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.
  • Updating CRM records and next steps.
  • Reviewing sequence performance and response rates.
  • Participating in pipeline reviews with the sales team.
  • Testing new messaging or prospecting approaches.

In short: you create qualified sales opportunities by combining disciplined prospecting, strong communication, effective qualification, and persistent follow-up.

Key Metrics for Success

  • 10–15 discovery calls per week
  • 8–12 qualified opportunities per month
  • Qualified meetings booked
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
  • Outbound response and connection rates
  • Daily and weekly prospecting activity
  • Pipeline generated

  • Consistency of prospect follow-up
  • 100% CRM data accuracy

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your experience as an SDR, BDR, or inside sales professional.
  • The types of B2B products or services you have sold.
